faqs.question: Is AIIMS Delhi hard to get admission in?
faqs.answer:
AIIMS Delhi offers admission for UG, PG, Doctoral and Super Speciality courses such as BSc, MSc, MD, MDS, MS, and PhD, among others. Admission to any of the course is conducted based on entrance. Therefore, candidates must  prepare for the accepted entrance exams such as NEET UG, AIIMS Paramedical Entrance Exam, INICET, Joint CSIR-UGC NET for JRF/ ICMR - JRF/ ICMR- SRF/ DBT - JRF/ NBHM screening test/ INSPIRE fellowship. 
The accepted entrance exams may vary as per the choice of course opted for. Candidates must analyse the cutoffs to learn more about the probability of qualifying for AIIMS Delhi and securing a seat. Although, every admission year is more challenging than the previous one, candidates can still make it by putting in some efforts and work on those grades.

faqs.question: What is the NEET UG Round 1 opening and closing rank for MBBS at AIIMS Delhi?
faqs.answer: NEET UG Round 1 cutoff has been released for the AIIMS Delhi MBBS course. The Opening and Closing ranks depend on the category and quota of candidates. As per the AIIMS Delhi cutoff 2024, the NEET UG Round 1 opening rank was 1 and the closing rank was 47 for the general category candidates under All India quota. Cut off are different when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even the domicile of home state. Admission to the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) at AIIMS Delhi is based on the scores obtained in the NEET UG entrance exam, followed by the NEET UG counselling process.

college_info.intro:
All India Institute of Medical Sciences AIIMS Delhi offers various programmes at several levels, such as UG, PG, PhD, etc. The programmes are offered across various fields, including Medicine, Nursing, Medical, and others. MBBS is the flagship programme of AIIMS Delhi. MBBS is offered for a duration of five and a half years.
The aforementioned duration also includes one year of compulsory internship. During the internship period, students are given practical training to become successful health practitioners. The internship period also includes ward posting. After the successful completion of the MBBS programme, students could either pursue higher education such as MD, MS, etc. or start their practice. All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi offers internships at its attached hospital, i.e., AIIMS Hospital New Delhi.
AIIMS Delhi also offers BSc and MSc courses. After completing the BSc Nursing course from the institute, students can become Home Care Nurses, Junior Psychiatric Nurses, Nursing Executives, and others. The organisations which recruit BSc Nursing students include The Indian Red Cross Society, Fortis Healthcare, Columbia Asia Hospital, and others. BSc Nursing students are taught the core values involving Empathy, Human Dignity, Professionalism, Integrity, Autonomy, and others. These values are very important while taking care of the patients. Overall with a degree in Medical Sciences, students can become Academic Researchers, Clinical Research Associates, and others.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: I am totally satisfied with the memories of college.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 80 percent of students got placed. The package offered ranges from 6-12 LPA. Government exams like NORCET are conducted by AIIMS for us. Internship is offered for the last 6 months with a stipend of Rs. 14,250, which we can use to cover our expenses. The top role offered is superintendent.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are top-level facilities in the classroom with Wi-Fi, labs, and the library. There are ventilation and AC rooms. It has a top-level hostel facility with a good mess and canteen. There are medical facilities for students and teaching staff members. Sports and games are also available in the sports ground.

reviews_list.batch_info: MD in Physiology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review about my college.

review_content.Placements: The placements are not guaranteed by the college as they make you perfect doctors and you have an option to either practice in a private clinic or else join some institute for presidentship. The interns could join the same institute once they clear the interview for the JRship, there's no such preference for the internal students. Being a medical college of course it provides an internship of 6 months giving you a chance to sit in each department. At present the interns are paid an amount of Rs. 18000 per month for their services.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many courses available under MD and Ph.D. degrees. These courses are remarkable and comparable to any other colleges in the state. Exam in the college is conducted semester-wise. A final exam is conducted and the results are considered for eligibility for placement. The hostel facility is excellent here with single rooms being allowed for each student, high-speed free Wi-Fi service, a lift in the hostels, and a common TV room on each floor. Each room is provided with a bed with mattress, a chair and table, and a godrej almirah making it perfect.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Technology (Radiography) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Nice, spectacular, peaceful environment of college and totally satisfied.

review_content.Placements: There is no one left unemployed after pursuing the degree. The highest package offered in this course is 20 LPA, the average package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Many medical companies like Vedanta and Medicare offer opportunities to us. You can serve as a radiographer, technical officer, senior technical officer, or chief technical officer.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a well-maintained library, Wi-Fi, and classrooms provided by AIIMS for students. There are a total of 14 messes, coffee shops, juice corners, a quad, and a playground for playing cricket, badminton, table tennis, basketball, etc. There is a well-established gym and swimming pool for students. The most interesting thing is that all of these facilities are free of cost.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Technology (Radiography) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Bachelor of medical radiology and imaging technology from AIIMS NEW DELHI.

review_content.Placements: After getting a pass out from this prestigious institute you have many opportunities to explore and on placements also you will get a good priority in comparison. The package depends on where you are working in which hospital institute or medical college you are working in a government sector and whether you are a permanent employee your package will be around 8 to 10 lacs per annum. The post will be radiographer after promotions you will be upgraded to technical officer then senior technical officer then chief technical officer. The package will also be increased according to your post.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied. It has value for money.

review_content.Placements: There are a total of 100 seats available. To get a government job as a Nursing Officer, students need to clear both the Prelims and Main exams of NORCET. Almost 80% of students get a job every year. 4th year students get internships in the last 6 months, paying up to Rs. 13,000 per month, before completing the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our campus is very neat and clean, with a guard every 20 meters, making it very safe. Our classes run in a lecture theatre with AC on it. We have a library running 24/7, and we have different departmental labs like anatomy and microbiology. Our hostel is also very good for single rooms to double and triple rooms with Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Biophysics - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in Delhi for medical studies.

review_content.Placements: It provided an adventurous experience as we had to manage numerous things at the same time like experience, learning, and trying to find leisure time in such a hectic program. I used to get a salary of Rs. 2,500 per month as a stipend. Overall, it is a very good place to practice medicine. Our college also has 3 primary health care centers (PHCs) which give a large scope for clinical practice. There is almost a 100% chance of getting a well-reputed job in a white coat with a good salary package and government facilities.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is not superb but it is good. I would rate it 7 out of 10 with single rooms, tables, beds, and a book track. Staff are cleaning the hostel every now and then. It is not great, but structure-wise, it is well-maintained.

course_faqs.question: Is AIIMS Delhi free of cost to study MBBS?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, AIIMS Delhi is almost free for all the programmes including MBBS MD MS PG Diploma M.Ch. DM DNB etc. For MBBS the admission charges (non-refundable) are INR 25 at the time of admission and INR 35 per day for the first 10 days. Other than this, there is no annual fee at AIIMS Delhi. Students must make a one-time payment between INR 5,000 to INR 6,000 which is the fee for the complete MBBS course of 5.5 years.

faqs.question: What are the USPs of AIIMS Delhi campus?
faqs.answer: Other than the beautiful, wi-fi enabled campus and a well maintained hostel and teaching campus, AIIMS New Delhi set up an Innovation Facilitation Division in 2017 for accommodating AIIMS faculty and scientists as incubatees. A Bio-Park is also under construction. MoU with other incubators to invite the startups for commercial ventures is also signed. AIIMS Delhi established a Centre for Integrative Medicine and Research (CIMR) in 2016 with an aim to build a convergence of contemporary medicine with India’s ancient and traditional medical practices. CIMR is dedicated to research, documentation and delivery of holistic healthcare. A patent has been granted to ‘Sealbio: a novel non-obturation regenerative technique of endodontic treatment’.

faqs.question: Is MSc affordable at AIIMS Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes, MSc is quite affordable at AIIMS Delhi. The total tuition fee for MSc is INR 1,400 . Candidates need to pay a one-time fee of INR 25 at the time of admission. AIIMS is a government institute and has a very low fee compared to other Medical colleges of India. faqs.question: What is the total cost of MBBS in AIIMS Delhi?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for MBBS at AIIMS Delhi is INR 6,080 . However, t his information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. fee payment is to be made in cash. Students must note that cheques, drafts, money orders, etc. will not be accepted in any case and the extension of the date for payment of dues isn't permitted in any case. Other than the tuition fee, the institute charges a lot of other components in the total fee, such as registration charges, caution deposits, student union and laboratory fee. These components are over and above the tuition fee mentioned above. For details on all the components and the official fee breaks, check out the MBBS brochure available in the quick links section of the above article.

faqs.question: Is AIIMS Delhi free of cost to study MBBS?
faqs.answer: Yes, AIIMS Delhi is almost free for all the programmes including MBBS MD MS PG Diploma M.Ch. DM DNB etc. For MBBS the admission charges (non-refundable) are INR 25 at the time of admission and INR 35 per day for the first 10 days. Other than this, there is no annual fee at AIIMS Delhi. Students must make a one-time payment between INR 5,000 to INR 6,000 which is the fee for the complete MBBS course of 5.5 years.

As per the overall score, AIIMS Delhi has been placed at a good position by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. sports.description: Ex and current students across various web pages online have mentioned that AIIMS Delhi offers an amazing sports facility. The campus has multiple badminton courts, an Olympic-sized swimming pool, a tennis court, a gym and various basketball, volleyball, squash and soccer courts. For indoor sports activities, there are multiple Table Tennis tables and a specific room with carom boards, foosball tables and Punching bags for boxing.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with the memories of college.
reviews.review_text: There are top-level facilities in the classroom with Wi-Fi, labs, and the library. There are ventilation and AC rooms. It has a top-level hostel facility with a good mess and canteen. There are medical facilities for students and teaching staff members. Sports and games are also available in the sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: There are many courses available under MD and Ph.D. degrees. These courses are remarkable and comparable to any other colleges in the state. Exam in the college is conducted semester-wise. A final exam is conducted and the results are considered for eligibility for placement. The hostel facility is excellent here with single rooms being allowed for each student, high-speed free Wi-Fi service, a lift in the hostels, and a common TV room on each floor. Each room is provided with a bed with mattres...

reviews.review_heading: Nice, spectacular, peaceful environment of college and totally satisfied.
reviews.review_text: There is a well-maintained library, Wi-Fi, and classrooms provided by AIIMS for students. There are a total of 14 messes, coffee shops, juice corners, a quad, and a playground for playing cricket, badminton, table tennis, basketball, etc. There is a well-established gym and swimming pool for students. The most interesting thing is that all of these facilities are free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Bachelor of medical radiology and imaging technology from AIIMS NEW DELHI.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is best but hostel availability is very low for paramedical courses it will take around 2 years for allotment to a hostel as names come on the waiting list. There is only one hostel which is hostel number 18 in which seats are allocated after allotment there is a minimum fee.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied. It has value for money.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is very neat and clean, with a guard every 20 meters, making it very safe. Our classes run in a lecture theatre with AC on it. We have a library running 24/7, and we have different departmental labs like anatomy and microbiology. Our hostel is also very good for single rooms to double and triple rooms with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Delhi for medical studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is not superb but it is good. I would rate it 7 out of 10 with single rooms, tables, beds, and a book track. Staff are cleaning the hostel every now and then. It is not great, but structure-wise, it is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: My college provides clinical postings in all departments like surgery, OT, neuro, cardio, etc.
reviews.review_text: My college campus has good facilities like security, coffee shop, library, swimming pool, gym facility, cafeteria, badminton games, park facility for jogging & walking, In my classroom, facilities are projectors and comfortable seating arrangements. Hostel timing is 6:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m., and campus timing is 24 hours available; the library is open all the time, as are the cafeteria and gym. Some park and library are good places for me. My college experience is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive nature of faculty members for students.
reviews.review_text: The annual function, PYREXIA, was held last year. It was very good, and I enjoyed it a lot. This year it is going to happen in October. There is a good library in college that has almost all the books required in MBBS. They also provide us with a free subscription to an online platform for studying.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied loved my journey
reviews.review_text: If we talk about facilities and infrastructure of course no doubt. They will give us best environment for outdoor game, study, tea breaks , enjoy with our batch mates and what not. If we talk about quality of mess food I say not best but not bad, it was moderate.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is known for its greenery.
reviews.review_text: In our rooms, we have full freedom to have whatever we want. Each room is equipped with two tubelights, a bed, an almirah, a mirror, washbasins, and a window. The meal quality is fair enough, and the menu differs on different days. Overall, the hostel facilities are nice and well-maintained. Hostel fee: INR 180 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is big. People can enjoy their campus life.
reviews.review_text: In first year, you get a room for 2 people, and it contains a cart, almirah, a study room, continuing a study table, a chair, a sink and there are messes in every hostel with different types of food. There are no separate washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my dream college AIIMS, Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi facility is provided in the hostel room and library. Classrooms are well-equipped with digital screens and air conditioning. Along with that, we are also provided with swimming pool, gym, library, reading rooms, and sports areas for table tennis, badminton, basketball, volleyball, etc. Mess and canteen food quality is fine. Medical facilities, including free treatment and medicine, is provided to all students.

reviews.review_heading: Nurses at AIIMS New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS Delhi is one of the top medical colleges in India. The campus area is very large, accommodating many departments and hostels. In this course, you will be taught in well-equipped classrooms with projectors, speakers, AC, etc. There are labs for practical knowledge, and a library that is open 24/7. The hostels for nursing students are very spacious, accommodating around 300-400 students. The rooms are well-furnished and ventilated. The hostel has a mess which serves good quality food and is ...

reviews.review_heading: The insights of AIIMS New Delhi. Personal and professional development.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of AIIMS is very vast. Every department has its own 10-story building, like surgical block, mother-and-child block, RPC eye centre, trauma centre and many more. The classrooms are equipped with modernized projector. There are labs for hematology, anatomy, physiology, etc. The library is very big. It has all medical books, new editions and publications. It has Wi-Fi and a big sitting area with air conditioned. It is 24/7 open for everyone. The hostel's facilities are very good....

reviews.review_heading: The truth about AIIMS Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Hostel mess fee was ₹1300 per year. The electricity and gym fees were ₹300 for a year. There are several fests organized, but the most amazing fest is Pulse at AIIMS, New Delhi. The classrooms are big and ventilated along with research labs being available for thesis research.

college_info.intro:
PGIMER Chandigarh India extends BSc and MSc as its flagship programmes. Both programmes are extended in full-time mode for the duration of 3 and 2 years. BSc is provided at the UG level with specialisations including Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology, Radiotherapy Technology, Medical Technology (Operation Theatre), Medical Technology (Perfusionist), Nursing, etc. On the other hand, MSc is offered at the PG level across specialisations, including Biochemistry, Medical Biotechnology, Pharmacology, Anatomy, etc.
For admission to these courses students must have a 55% aggregate in the qualifying exam scores for MSc (PG) courses and pass Class 10 and Class 12 with a 50% aggregate and subjects of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/Biology (PCM/B) or Diploma in relevant subject for the BSc (UG) courses. content.Placements: Basically, there is no placement cell for our course. Only 26% of students got placed in a research project under department faculty. placement_data.title: PGIMER Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: PGIMER Chandigarh has not published an official placement report. However, the NIRF Report 2025 has been out for the institute. As per the report, the median package offered to UG 3 and UG 4-Year sudents during placements 2024 was INR 10 LPA each. While the median package offered to PG 2-year placements 2024 was INR 11.5 LPA . The median package offered to PG 3-year students was INR 30 LPA during the PGIMER Chandigarh placements 2024.

As per PGIMER NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during PG 2-year and PG 3-year placements 2023 stood at INR 9 LPA and INR 18 LPA , respectively. Further, a total of 60 students were placed out of 70 students during PG 2-year placements whereas 200 students were placed and 35 students opted for higher studies out of 250 students during PG 3-year placements 2023.

Earlier, the NIRF report 2023 is out. According to the report, 40 PG (2-year) and 165 PG (3-year) students were placed during PGIMER Chandigarh placements 2022. Further, the median package offered to PG (2-year) and PG (3-year) students during 2022 placements was INR 8 LPA and INR 17 LPA, respectively.

college_info.intro:
CMC Vellore Tamil Nadu popular programmes are MBBS, MBA, BSc, and others. MBBS is the flagship programme of CMC Vellore. MBBS is offered for a duration of five and a half years. The aforementioned duration also includes one year of compulsory internship. During the internship period, students are given practical training to become successful health practitioners. The internship period also includes ward posting. After the successful completion of the MBBS programme, students could either pursue higher education such as MD, MS, etc., or can start their practice. CMC Vellore offers internships at its attached hospital, i.e., CMCHospital Vellore.
CMC BSc students get jobs in top companies. The organisations which recruit BSc Nursing students include The Indian Red Cross Society, Fortis Healthcare, Columbia Asia Hospital, and others. BSc Nursing students are taught the core values involving Empathy, Human Dignity, Professionalism, Integrity, Autonomy, and others. These values are very important while taking care of the patients.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for M.Sc. in Medical Physics course.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, libraries contain a wide range of literature to assist pupils learn, and computer labs include a choice of machines. College also boasts adequate hostel facilities, with three beds in one room, and canteen delivers high-quality meals. College offers a variety of sports and medical services.

reviews.review_heading: B.Sc. in medical laboratory technology.
reviews.review_text: It was essential to follow the dress code insisted on by the management. The dress code was not only for students but also for teachers. Specialized laboratories were arranged with a special setup. On all special occasions, the student in charge represented the college.

reviews.review_heading: A well-disciplined college for medicine.
reviews.review_text: All the medical students are required to stay in the hostel to provide hands-on training without any delays. Courses should be offered at affordable prices, which include hostel fees and tuition fees. Students are not allowed outside campus on weekdays. Parents are allowed to visit only on weekends.

reviews.review_heading: The Postgraduate Diploma in Family Medicine is exclusively for freshers in doctor.
reviews.review_text: I'm sure this was one of the most restricted campuses, following a specific set of principles to make the campus value-based. They gave priority to building disciplined students over other aspects. A sports complex with features like indoor and outdoor games, as well as a badminton complex, was included.

reviews.review_heading: Postgraduate Diploma in Mental Health at CMC Vellore.
reviews.review_text: The quantity and quality of food provided in the mess were acceptable to eat. Students suggestions were considered before providing a menu for the working days. Only a limited variety of food was cooked on all days. The campus was well spread, with a lot of seating for relaxation, which helped relieve our stress.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Christian Medical College, Vellore.
reviews.review_text: CMC had several departments and separate buildings for the department of nursing and allied health sciences for medicine. A centralized library located at the center of the campus that offered comprehensive learning experience. So departmental libraries arranged for all the departments.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in our area.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college was poor in comparison with the other colleges. Although most facilities, like library, Wi-Fi, etc., were available. The maintenance part was really bad. The food we get in hostel is okay. Hostel had good facilities. Sports were conducted in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for medicos.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we have well-equipped classrooms, Wi-Fi, simulation labs for every department, a very good library, computer lab, chapel, etc. The infrastructure of the hostel is very good, the rooms are very sophisticated, there are a gym, pantry, prayer room, recreation hall, library, and much more in the hostel. The mess food is very good. The meal is planned based on the RDA.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2018Offered by Christian Medical College Vellore, Chittoor CampusReviewed on 30 Apr 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and proper knowledge were given to the students.

All the necessary facilities were available in the labs of the college for the medical students. A library and multiple sports facilities were also provided to the students. The hostel facilities were of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Take admission and enjoy life.

reviews.review_heading: The Heaven College CMC Medical.

reviews.review_heading: Heaven Christian medical college.

paragraphs: JIPMER admission to all the courses is entrance exam-based. The institute accepts national-level entrance exams such as NEET, INI CET, etc. for admission to specific courses. JIPMER also conducts its very own entrance exams for admission to several courses. All the entrance exams are conducted in theEnglishlanguage only. Admission to allJIPMER(UG, PG, and certificate) is entirely entrance-based. Eligible candidates can register online through the official website of the university.

JIPMER offers various UG, PG, super-speciality, and post-doctoral level programmes in the stream of Medicine and Health Sciences. The courses at JIPMER include BSc, MBBS, MSc, Master of Public Health, MD, MS, Post Graduate Diploma, Post Graduate Fellowship, Post-Baccalaureate Diploma (PBD), PhD, and Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF).

For admission toJIPMER courses, candidates must fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria and pass the selection criteria. Applications of only the eligible students are treated as valid. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection details for some of the popularJIPMER courses:

1. JIPMER Pondicherry Application Process 2025

Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research accepts applications via online mode. The admission form shall be available in offline mode as well. Candidates must fill in all the details in the application carefully. Also, the application must be submitted on or before the deadline.
2. Release of Merit List

After the conclusion of the application process or before form filling (For some courses), the merit list is released by the institute. The cutoff list indicates the minimum required score in the particular exam for a candidate to become eligible for admission. Aspirants with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks qualify for the next selection round.
3. Counselling
The merit list candidates further have to participate in the course counselling round. During this process, the institute may verify the candidate's documents and allot seats.
4. Admission Confirmation
After seat allotment, selected students shall pay the required amount of fees to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: Can I take admission in MBBS at JIPMER Puducherry without NEET?
faqs.answer: No, JIPMER Puducherry admit candidates to its MBBS programme based on merit in NEET only. reviews.review_heading: Very good campus life, ragging free campus, and lot of exposure apart from books.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was very good as it was a central government institute. For books, we had a central library and book bank also. Classrooms were well-equipped with advanced technology. Indoor stadium, basketball, futsal, cricket, etc., were there.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: It has well-developed infrastructure and facilities that support medical education, research, and patient care. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are available. We also have a central library, which is large and we also have a modern library with thousands of medical books and journals. Quality of food is good, and the mess and canteen are too well. Food is made with hygiene and is healthy.

reviews.review_heading: Security service has to be more strict.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities and infrastructure available for our department were good. The security arrangements were not so tight. Anyone could enter the college. Classrooms and labs were in good condition. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen was hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: About exceptional optometry course w/practical, camps, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college has Wi-Fi, practical labs, projector based classrooms, seminar rooms, and library facilities (24X7). Single rooms and shared rooms are available in hostels. Mess food is available from different messes with variety of dishes. Medical facilities for students are more concerned. Sports and other activities are more practiced on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The best institute with high-level infrastructure and facilities to grow.
reviews.review_text: AC and Wi-Fi are available in academic centers 24/7. A central library that has AC and Wi-Fi. Hostel rooms are generally shared by two, with laundry facilities. The fee structure is very minimal, and people are friendly and respectful. There is excellence in academics and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a hygienic campus with professional faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Training and practical classes are done in the hospital of JIMPER, which is within the college campus. Hostel fees are slightly higher than expected. Education fees are given to the students based on their marks in the entrance examinations. Students must dress formally.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely the best college for medical education be it any course MBBS or paramedical courses.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel complex, library, hospital, academic complex, and everything is nice with good maintenance. There is 24/7 Wi-Fi and all other necessities. In the hostel, cleanliness is maintained well. It has facilities like water and 24/7 electricity.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: Most amazing and relaxing environment, so students from various areas prefer to do their college at JIPMER, Puducherry. It is compulsory to wear white coats and carry stethoscopes daily. A separate canteen is available for the students and for the hospital visitors.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty members. Good infrastructure and library.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned and well-maintained with advanced smart classrooms and wi-fi is available. Library contains good resources and books, library has a good calm condition for studying and a good collection of books and is research-friendly.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by JIPMER Karaikal - Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and ResearchReviewed on 8 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: "Best university through NEET UG, offering the best study exposure, clinical knowledge, and faculty
reviews.review_text: We have smart classrooms with AC, 5G Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, more than enough microscopes, machines, facilities, etc. The library is equipped with all standard and regional books from all authors. E-library facility is also there. There are cricket and football grounds, a TT hall, and a badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: Memories in JIPMER campus.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are air-conditioned with enough space. Lectures are taken by faculty members and are of very good quality. There is JIPMER Wi-Fi available for students' use. Our hostel, Nightingale, is near the College of Nursing. In the hostel, three persons are accommodated in one room. If you want a single room, you can get it in the third year. JIPMER also has facilities for futsal, basketball, and throwball.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and the library are available 24 hours. All types of messes are available. There are wide-spaced, full, and well-ventilated classrooms; some of them have AC also. You will have any medical facility once you are a student; you have consideration also. Different types of sports and courts are available here.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good college to study paramedics and MBBS.
reviews.review_text: In hostels, it is very clean, and there are maids for cleaning the rooms and doing laundry. Also, we can cook in the pantry room, and they also provide kettles for making hot water or tea. There are heaters in bathrooms, and hostels are very clean, and a 24-hour security system is there.

reviews.review_heading: Best place for those who want to be a great doctor.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, and all labs have advanced classrooms that can accommodate 200+ students. The library works 24/7 with air conditioning. Food is average and not very good. Single and double room hostels are available, and there are many cultural programs and games, including indoor and outdoor activities. JIPMER Wi-Fi is available almost all over the campus.

reviews.review_heading: My campus through my eyes.
reviews.review_text: JIPMER provides free Wi-Fi for students everywhere in the campus. The vast and spacious library is open for students for 24 hours and it is so special. It contains a lot of medical books and journals and JIPMER has a lot of sports items.

review_summary.college_name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons) in Chemistry with Botany - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College placement is not so good, their percentage is very low.

content.Placements: The strength of my class is 79. Almost all students get an internship. Colleges offer students the opportunity to got internship from another college or industry. If they do not approach any industry or college, then the college itself provides the internship. The average package forwarded in my courses is Rs. 50000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Lab in the first and 2nd semester is done once a week, and in the third semester it is twice a week, and in the 4th semester it is 4 days a week. There are two batches of Chemistry. The maximum number of students doing lab together is 30 or more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want a good package, then you should join this college.

content.Placements: Almost 95-96 percent of students in electrical have been placed. The highest package given is 1.2 crore per annum, which was in the field of cybersecurity. The lowest is around 12 LPA, and the average package is around 27 LPA, while the median is around 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and Nvidia. Around 50 percent of students from electrical engineering grab an internship. Specifically, this year, 55 students got an internship. [8 core and rest non-core ] Top roles include SDE, cybersecurity, VLSI designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Sometimes there is a problem with Wi-Fi connectivity in our hostel rooms. The library is very good, and it contains all types of books that are required. Classrooms are okay. Labs are very good, but some of the equipment has mechanical errors. The medical facility is excellent. Food quality depends on which type of mess you have joined, like in a sattvik mess, where Jain food is served, the quality of food is excellent compared to other messes. The sports facility is also very good. The canteen also provides good food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college IIT BHU because of facilities and good placement in 2026.

content.Placements: In the electronics branch, the placement percentage is approximately 81 percent. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 7.5 LPA, and the average is 23.5 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia. 40 percent of students got internships in core jobs, where the major company was Nvidia, and a few also got internships in SDE. Roles include VLSI, embedded systems, and PCB.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good at IIT BHU. Wi-Fi covers the entire campus, and classrooms are fully modernized. There are 4 lecture theatres in our college. For freshers, IIT BHU has the best hostel among all IITs, named PC Ray Hostel, which covers all required infrastructure and is newly made, so it looks aesthetic as well. There are 3 huge grounds in IIT BHU, which cover facilities for all sports. We have SAC for indoor games and a newly made gym, which is the biggest sports auditorium as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college is the best for serious students.

content.Placements: There were very few placement offers, because most of the students preferred higher studies in their respective fields. Actually, since there was no specific placement cell for UG students, there was a very low number of students who got placed, i.e., 30-40 percent of students were getting placed or less than that.
content.Infrastructure: There was a decent hostel in our college, which was not too good, but there were some basic facilities provided by the hostel, like free Wi-Fi, and there was also a place for playing outdoor games. Overall, it was 7/10, and the infrastructure of the course was good. You don't have much pressure, you have time to explore new things and find your interests.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Dairy Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average for dairy, above average for college life.

paragraphs: BHU admissionsare primarily entrance-based. All Indian applicants are required to take the CUET-UG exam conducted by the NTA. Candidates must apply online on the NTA CUET official website to register themselves. For PG courses, aspirants with a valid CUET-PG score can apply. Admission to some courses can be merit-based. BHU considers CUET-UG scores and normalised scores to create merit lists for each course.
What is the BHU Application Process 2026?

For UG courses admission through CUET, candidates have to complete theCUET-UG application process. Likewise, forBHU PG admissions, theCUET-PG applicationprocess has to be completed. For other courses, the aspirants can apply through BHU official website.

BHU counselling process for PG courses through CUET-PG is carried out in online mode. Registrations for it get started before CUET results are out and open after that for scorecard upload. Find below the detailed procedure of BHU CUET-PG counselling:
1 -Register on theBHU admission portal

Visit the university's official website(bhuonline.in)to participate in the online counselling process. To register, enter yourNTA application number, and other details along with your email ID and a passwordto activate the registration account.

Login with the Email ID and password entered during registration. After login, fill out the application and upload documents. Candidates must upload the documents inPDF/JPEG format. Moreover, the required documents are enlisted below:
Matriculation or its equivalent certificate
Class 12 mark sheet
Bachelor's mark sheet (make a single file of marks sheet of all semesters and then upload the same as a single document)
Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) and income certificate (SC/ST)
PwD certificate (if applicable)
BHU employee certificate (if applicable)
Certificate if admission under sports quota
Scanned copy of a recent colour photograph & signature
3 -Pay the BHU Counselling Registration Fee

In order to register successfully, anon-refundablefee has to be paid via debit card/credit card/net banking. Candidates canedit the application before fee payment. Find below the registration fee for each of the categories:
4 -Preference Entry Page

The preference entry page opens after the registration fee payment. Candidates can fill in their preferences separately for all the programmes in this form. Moreover, the result for the first seat allotment is declared within 8 to 10 days (approximately) after the publication of theCUET-PG result. Further, subsequent rounds for regular/paid fee seats for the BHU and affiliated colleges are carried out.

BHU feesinclude various components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, library fees, etc. The fee payment shall be accepted annually or semester-wise. BHU fee structure varies depending upon the chosen course. It also varies for regular and paid seats. Candidates wanting to apply for afee refund from BHUhave to fill out a form. Students can download the new BHU fee refund formhere. The table given below mentions theBHU feesof some of the courses:
NOTE:The aforementioned course fee is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to changes and hence is indicative.

The university provides seat reservations toSC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged. Moreover, the university has also paid seats (a maximum of 15% of the total seats). faqs.question: Does BHU accept admission through CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banaras Hindu University accept CUET score for multiple UG courses, including BA (Hons), BCom (Hons) BSc (Hons), etc. The university is also offering admission to its PG courses based on merit in CUET-PG. Aspirants who meet the eligibility requirements can register on the BHU admission portal for counselling. The admission is done in order of merit based on the normalised score of the CUET (PG) and reservation policy as per the provisions laid down in the BHU PET Information Brochure.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for the BHU UET?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET-UG scores for admission to several UG courses. Candidates seeking admission to BHU must apply online to register themselves. Follow the step-wise admission process as given below:The BHU application process is conducted in online mode through the official website of NTA (nta.ac.in). The fee for General category students is INR 750, INR 700 for OBC-NCL/EWS, and INR 650 for SC/ST/PwD/Transgender.Candidates need to download the admit card by visiting the official website of CUET 2025 and clicking on 'Download CUET Admit Card'.After the declaration of the CUET result, students seeking admission to BHU UG courses are required to apply online for CUET-UG Counselling on the BHU UG admission portal.Further, candidates are required to participate in an online counselling process for provisional admission to the course (s). After that, the final seat allotment will be done by BHU.

faqs.question: What is the last date for BHU admission?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET scores for admission to UG and PG courses. The admissions are over within few weeks of CUET counselling. CUET-PG is usually jeld in March whereas, CUET-UG takes place in May. Students must check the complete schedule for exact dates. CUET applications for the coming year will begin in February and continue till April.

faqs.question: Can a one-year dropper student get admission into BHU?
faqs.answer: Banaras Hindu University course admissions is entrance-based for most of the programmes. Thus, one-year dropper student can apply for the desired course, however, qualifying the respective entrance is the a must. Apart from this, aspirant should meet the course-specific minimum eligibility requirements as well.Moreover, the student can be asked to submit an application regarding the reason for drop out. Sometimes even this is not required.

placement_data.title: Banaras Hindu University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest and average package recorded during BHU MBA & MBA IB placements 2025 were INR 19.8 LPA and INR 10.1 LPA , respectively. For MBA Agri-Business course, the highest and average package recorded this year were INR 16 LPA and INR 8.7 LPA . During Banaras Hindu University MBA and MBA IB placements 2025, most number of profiles offered was of Consultant whereas for MBA Agri-Business program, Management Trainee emerged as the top profile.

According to the NIRF report 2025 released the median package offered to UG 3 year was INR 8 LPA during the BHU placements 2024. Moreover, the median packages offered to UG 4 Year and UG 5 Year were INR 9 LPA and INR 16 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package received during BHU placement 2024 for PG 2-year and PG 3-year programs were INR 9 LPA and INR 13.5 LPA , respectively.

individual_reviews.title: Excellent clinical exposure, supportive faculty, and vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: MBBS courses in government medical colleges in India, including MLNMC Prayagraj, do not offer traditional campus placements like engineering or management institutes. Medical graduates are required to undergo a Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship for one year. After this, there is a bond of two years to serve as a government doctor in rural hospitals and PHC centres. After this, some graduates take the NEET PG exam and secure a seat in MD/MS courses to pursue post-graduation. Some graduates directly apply as general physicians in private hospital, PHCs, Tutors, and some open their own clinics.

faqs.question: What is the NEET SS application fee?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS application fee is INR 3,500. The fee is same for candidates belonging to each category. This is the application fee for each group. Hence, candidates planning to apply for two groups will have to pay INR 7,000 (3,500 + 3,500). The fee has to be paid in online mode, via credit/debit card or net banking. NBE states, "Applications forms once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Fee shall neither be carried forward to a future date nor refunded under any circumstances. Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Any claim for refund, adjustment or carrying forward of Application fee will not be entertained. Examination fees in respect of candidates who are absent or have been declared ineligible due to any reason will be forfeited." As compared to last year, the fee has been reduced. Last year, the fee amount was INR 4,250 for each group.

I am a day scholar student, so I have no idea about the hostel, but the hostel looks like it gives good facilities for students. There is lunch, and dinner might be good, but not every day.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Motilal Nehru Medical College, AllahabadReviewed on 22 Apr 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfaction for academic purpose and surroundings. Seniors are very helpful.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are very good you get a shared room in your early year and then after 3 years, you get a single room. Electricity is always available. Infrastructure is above average. There are multiple mess and each of them serves good hygienic food and a water cooler is also there. Classrooms are well-established and AC furnished. Projectors are placed for visual studies.

reviews.review_heading: King George's Medical University - A medical palace.
reviews.review_text: The campus is astonishing. It is better to say it is a medical palace. Feeling proud to be there. Classrooms, a canteen, and the hostel infrastructure are highly developed compared to any other college. The hostel is good. Mess facilities are provided. The hostel in time is 10 PM. You can enjoy the campus as every place is very beautifully maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Real insight from a Georgian.
reviews.review_text: We had Wi-Fi in both the hostel and campus. Labs and classrooms were very spacious, with classrooms that could accommodate 250 students. The hostel was top-notch, with double-sharing rooms, and every student had a separate almirah and study table. Every room had an attached balcony. The mess was awesome, offering sumptuous meals like dosa, idli, and dahi bade.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Vivekanand College of Nursing, LucknowReviewed on 22 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college in terms of knowledge and skill development. It also has good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is pretty good, and if we look externally, our college looks pretty good. The main thing is it has a clean and hygienic environment which our college maintains and makes it pretty attractive. Classrooms are calm with a quiet environment in which students can study quietly with full concentration. Our college has a library with a variety of course books and fictional books.

reviews.review_heading: KGMU College of Nursing, Best Place for Nursing.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there is Wi-Fi available for the students, which they need to register for first at the IT cell of the college. The lecture halls are fully air-conditioned, and there is a fire safety system in each class. We are provided with a health card, with which we can get our health checkups.

reviews.review_heading: A really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college are proper water facilities, projectors, AC classrooms, fire alarms on each and every floor with water sprays attached in every classroom, labs for better understanding of students, and a library where you can find your course books easily. The quality of the hostel is not that good; I would rate it as average. The mess and canteen are good. Events are organized every year, such as Sports Week, where different games like the 400-meter run race and relay rac...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Science, LucknowReviewed on 18 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Little dissatisfied about not having proper sports facilities but good in academics.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and hostel facilities are great as we got a 3BHK, and 6 students live with a facility of geyser etc. My hostel is in front of the Palassio Mall and Ekana Stadium where we can enjoy the cricket matches just near us (if tickets are having).

reviews.review_heading: Best college for doing nursing as high quality education is provided.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi all over the university. Pediatrics lab, anatomy lab, nursing foundation lab, community health nursing lab. Hostel mess is available. Canteen in the hostel. Health cards for students for free service are available. A ground for sports and games. Excellent campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college is awesome, and education and faculty are exceptional.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is awesome. We have air-conditioned classrooms, advanced labs with instruments, and a library that has lots of books. The hostel is also provided; the fee is 4900 per year. There is a mess to which you have to pay yourself, and there is a study hall provided.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely beautiful and fantastic with good placement.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very good infrastructure, and all the departments are equipped with the best of everything. The classrooms are very spacious and comfortable and equipped with ventilation and good lighting. Sports activities are also done in our college. Hostel facilities also have Wi-Fi and good food.

reviews.review_heading: It is the most rated college for medicine.
reviews.review_text: Firstly, without wearing white coats, we aren't allowed inside the campus. There is tight security at the gate, and entry is allowed after proper record entries. Mostly, the mess is so rushed all the time because students from the hostel also use the mess to have their food. Visitors are not allowed inside the campus without a proper security check.

reviews.review_heading: Successful college in Manipal.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories for pathology, anatomy, and biochemistry were individually isolated and arranged. Basically, needed preservatives and equipment were arranged before lab sessions by the lab assistants. Campus food was hygienic and suitable for all kinds of people.

reviews.review_heading: The premier medical college.
reviews.review_text: Within the college campus hospitals were opened, which made it very easy for students to attend training sessions. In the hospital, more than 1000 beds were arranged to give training for students based on real-time cases. Events and sports were not encouraged by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Kasturba Medical College, Manipal.
reviews.review_text:
1.Lecture:- 
Lecture halls are big and accommodate half of batch at a time. Fully air-conditioned and well lit.
Speakers are good too. Faculty usually use PowerPoint and projectors. 
2. Hostels : 
Three types of hostels are available for boys. Hostel room with minimum cost are also nice. The expensive one is quite luxurious.
3. Library:-
The library is the best place of the college. It is huge and has ambiance for study.
4.Mess:- 
Mess is also clean and decent. They serve healthy meals. But once...

reviews.review_heading: MBBS is difficult, but worth is in the END.
reviews.review_text: There is a free Wi-Fi facility in both the hostel and the library. The classes are well maintained, and everywhere is air-conditioned. The mess food is hygienic, and there is a sports facility known as MARENA, which takes a subscription but has all the sports, whatever.

reviews.review_heading: Kasturba medical College : comprehensive review.
reviews.review_text: The college has a lot of high-tech facilities that are academic-related. For example, the labs are great, everything is up-to-date and the latest, there is no overcrowding of classrooms, and the seating is very comfortable. The projector is great, and the study environment, including AC, is great. All the hostels have Wi-Fi facilities. It is a little difficult to find Wi-Fi in the labs and hospital, but it can be done if you get the official password. The hostels range from cheap to expensive. T...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, placements in our batch were good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, with many facilities available. There is a good library with two library cards. We can take any two books home for 15 days to read, after which we need to renew. The hostel facilities are also good. The mess and canteen have good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I did my MBBS from Kasturba College.
reviews.review_text: This college had very good infrastructure for the MBBS course. The college had all the medical facilities for students' practical and interactive learning. Wi-Fi, library, canteen, labs, etc., were available on the campus for the students of our course.

reviews.review_heading: Kasturba medical college - A college of excellence.
reviews.review_text:
Medical facilities are excellent.
Huge gym of 7 floors including table tennis, badminton, squash, swimming, etc. Classrooms are air conditioned. Hostel facilities are average. Multiple hostels are there so some hostels very good while some are average.
There is a large library of 7 floors and museum of anatomy as well.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best private college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has good Wi-Fi, which is around 10 Mbps. Our classrooms have projectors. There are test dummies through which we can learn how to do certain clinical examinations. The library has six floors and can give you virtually any book you want related to medicine.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is great with good campus life.
reviews.review_text: It provides good Wi-Fi. The mess food is not good, and the hostels are great. It provides air-conditioners and hostels are available. It has a 7-floor sports facility called Mareena, and students have a fest, and many more cultural activities are available.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best private universities for medical aspirants.
reviews.review_text: It is an amazing place. There is a good mix of all kinds of students. Labs and classrooms are amazing as KMC has a strong focus on infrastructure. The whole city is good in general, and the class size is small. There are a lot of places nearby to relax. KMC spends a lot on infrastructure, so there are no complaints regarding that. You will also find good vacation stops nearby.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a very good infrastructure and the teachers are really supportive.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is amazing. It is an open campus and the hospital is huge with different blocks for different departments. For sports, they have a big ground in MIT.
Also, it has a place called Arena that is a 7-floor building dedicated to sports. Although it is a bit costly, you'll get almost every variety of games there.

reviews.review_heading: I have an amazing experience. It is one of the best deemed medical colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is top-notch. Our library, labs, dissection hall and other infrastructure are the best and biggest. The hostel is amazing, with air-conditioned rooms optional. The canteen near our hostel serves very delicious food. Sports are up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good, and our college deserves to be among the top colleges.
reviews.review_text: The library is fully equipped with Wi-Fi facility and all the books related to the course. Food served in the mess is above average. Other facilities are also good. Our college also provides air-conditioned rooms for students. There is also a sports complex nearby which has all the required equipment for students.

overview_faqs.question: Does Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: Several salient features of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' return policy are: The majority of the institute's programs, including MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, and others, have clear return policies. After deducting administrative fees, funds are reimbursed to students who opt to withdraw their acceptance prior to the final day of admission. Usually, 1-2 weeks after classes begin, the deadline for admissions is reached. The following guidelines will apply to refunds in the event that a student departs after the final admissions date: Refundable 75% of fees if departure occurs within 30 days before the deadline (registration expenses excluded). Refundable 50% of fees if departure occurs within 30 to 90 days. If you depart after the final admittance date, you won't get a refund. A refund application must be completed.

All admissions granted by SIMATS Chennai are provisional in nature. The confirmation of admissions for SIMATS, Chennai is done by theAnna University/ Directorate of Technical Education, Chennai to which, the institute is affiliated.

Also known asSaveetha University,SIMATS, Chennai offers various courses at UG, PG, and PhD levels across the fields of Engineering, Architecture, Law, Nursing, Medical, and Management. The scores obtained in the NEET-UG, GATE, TANCET and TNEA entrance exams are used to decide the Saveetha Universityadmissions to theMBBS, BTech, MBA, and MTech courses respectively.

placement_data.title: SIMTS Placement Overview 2023
paragraphs: The details for the 2023 drive are not released as of now. However, the NIRF report 2023 is out. According to the report, 108 MBA, 121 LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB, 30 LLM, 1,080 BTech, 28 MTech, 69 BDS, 40 MDS and 56 MD students were placed during Saveetha University placements 2022. The median package offered to MBA, LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB and LLM students stood at INR 6.45 LPA, INR 5.8 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively. For BTech and MTech courses, the median package offered was INR 3.8 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA. Further, for BDS, MDS and MD students, the median package offered during Saveetha University placements 2022 was INR 3.8 LPA, INR 6 LPA and INR 15.6 LPA, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: Mirror of my college life, thought.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was too good. Classes were also nice. Wi-Fi is also available. Library is too good. Basically, I am not a hostel student. I don't know about the hostel, but the college classroom and library were nice. Blindly, we can give  5-star ratings for that.

reviews.review_heading: Saveetha Institute has good infrastructure, facilities, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The best thing about my college is its infrastructure. I guarantee that my college has one of the best infrastructure and it may take us at least 3 months to discover all of them one by one between my college hostel and amenities are good. There is no need to worry about food as there are more than 60 canteens in my college. We will have the best campus life here in Saveetha. There are medical facilities (we never need to worry as the campus has the best hospital within SMC). It also has sports ...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with studies. It provides really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: It provides Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, research rooms, and prototype labs. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is very much good. The quality of food is different, maybe be on our expenses. There is a medical college available on the college premises. So the medical facilities are 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college especially with some faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Basically, infrastructure is awesome and there are more facilities available in the classrooms. Also, free Wi-Fi library is always open till 7.00 PM, and hostels are two types AC/non-AC. There is only canteen for hostellers they will not provide food, we have to buy from the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: My college is awesome and done your admission for 2025 shine your life and knowledge in academics.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very well and looks so impressive. It has contains appropriate labs for students for practical sessions and classrooms for theory classes. Wi-Fi facility and a library with a wide range of standard books are also available. Our college hostel offers many facilities, like good food served three times per day in a full hygienic way. There is a separate canteen for each department, and medical facilities are available for students. Many sports and game competitions are...

reviews.review_heading: A good college can be recommended but can improve in some things.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The classes are good. The hostel needs some improvement and the canteen foods are so good that they are just like in restaurants but a little high cost. The library is good but can keep the books that can be taken and read by the students but the books are locked in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and high placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college has one of the best infrastructures. Every classroom is provided with good tables and chairs, and each classroom has fans and AC. Wi-Fi is available inside the college premises. There are many hostels in our college, separate for boys and girls. Each college coming under our university has different hostels. Mess and canteen food are not up to the mark, but it's fine. Our college gives more importance to sports and other extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at SIMATS .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. You will have air-conditioned classrooms, Wi-Fi facilities are there, a library, etc. In a hostel, you have 2 sharing, 4 sharing, and 12 sharing rooms with AC facilities. Mess and canteen foods are available. If you want to hike, there are so many places on campus.

reviews.review_heading: SIMATS: the more you explore, the more you know.
reviews.review_text: Every hostel has Wi-Fi. The infrastructure of this college is more attractive than expected. The classrooms are so clean and hygienic. The hostel is also so good. On our campus, there are more than 15 hostels. Every hostel has its own uniqueness, like 4 in 1 AC, 6 in 1 AC,  8 in 1 AC, and 2 in 1 AC and there are non-AC rooms in hostels. The food is better than any other college in Chennai.

reviews.review_heading: Top notch infrastructure and facilities, excellent campus life, average food quality.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch. One of the best infrastructures we can see. The classrooms are good, and the bathrooms are clean and neat. Wi-Fi is available 24 hours a day, and a projector is available for all classes. The labs are air-conditioned and well-cleaned. The library is very big, and it consists of all kinds of books related to your studies. Canteen food is above average, and a food court is available, but the management is poor. The quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Saveetha college experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent, with all the basic and top-end facilities available in our college. There are separate laboratories for each and every department and there are different labs for each further division in each department. Wi-Fi is available for the students. There are 4 libraries in our college with a great atmosphere to study in. There are many hostels in our college (approximately 10), and each hostel has its own rules and regulations. Food is comparatively bette...

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with all the facilities provided by our college management.
reviews.review_text: Excellent facilities were offered by the college management. The quality of food will be very good, the classroom infrastructure is also good. Medical facilities were also good. Labs, classrooms infrastructure were also good. The facilities is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms have all the facilities with smart amenities. The infrastructure of the college is excellent. There were Library, Laboratories, Seminar halls, etc. and all of them were well maintained. The college campus has Wi-Fi facilities. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to gain and expand your knowledge and future but dissatisfied to the core in other areas.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar but my friends who reside in hostels weren't satisfied either. They showed me a picture of dead bugs and worms in their food. That alone is a major concern. No action was taken by the management related to the quality of the food provided. That explains a lot. The rooms are okay but not worth it. INR 80–90k in hostel fees is too much for a mediocre room and disease-carrying food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences, Poonamallee.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were decent. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Computers were also available in this college. Laboratories were excellent. There was a decent library in this college. Hostel facilities were great. The security facility was good in our hostel. The food quality was decent. Sports were conducted in this college. Medical facilities were also provided for emergency purposes. Hospital was also available on our campus.

placement_data.title: AIIMS Rishikesh Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: The median package recorded during UG 5-year and PG 3-year placements 2023 was INR 12.4 LPA and INR 24.1 LPA. Other than this, 20 UG 5-year students were placed and 74 students were selected for higher studies out of total 94 students. During AIIMS Rishikesh PG 3-year placements, 259 students were placed and 6 students were selected for higher studies out of total 265 students.

faqs.question: How are MBBS placements at AIIMS, Rishikesh?
faqs.answer: The MBBS placements at AIIMS, Rishikesh, further put their students through the paces capitalizing on getting a median package of INR 12.00 to 12.20 LPA as graduates. Amongst a pool of about 94 and 93 students in the 5-year scheme, around 54 and 56 students got employment opportunities. On the top of all, the recruitment stats for the postgraduate programme show a very competitive package of INR 20.00 to 21.60 LPA. The graduate students of AIIMSR who land prestigious first-round placements manifest the institution's firm belief in ensuring remarkable career paths for its medical graduates.

faqs.question: How are PG Diploma placements at AIIMS Rishikesh?
faqs.answer: The median package for PG 3-year courses is INR 20.00 LPA, while the median package for PG 2-year (MSc, PG Diploma) courses is INR 12.96 LPA. According to the AIIMS Rishikesh placement report of 2 year PG programme, 2020, 8 students were eligible for placement, out of which 8 got placed, and the median salary offered to the student in the same year is INR 50,000. The placement rate for PG 3-year courses was 91% in 2021, with 107 students placed out of 191 total students.

reviews.review_heading: College situated in Dev Bhoomi, the land of mother Ganga.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good. We have air-conditioned, good seats, and good strength to accommodate people. Library has everything available like air-conditioning, all books, Wi-Fi, and a central library. There is no AC in hostel. Hostel for boys is okay, not as good as girls' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: All you need to know about AIIMS Rishikesh.
reviews.review_text: Our college has various LTs where batch-wise regular classes are held. Our classes are well-equipped with central ACs, projectors, and green boards. The classroom is pretty well-equipped for the accommodation of 200 students. We also have department-wise labs, and the labs are well-equipped with all instruments and other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Inside of AIIMS rishikesh .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of AIIMS Rishikesh is great. Classrooms are large with comfortable desks, and all the classes have AC facilities and Wi-Fi. Labs are also nice, equipped with great technologies. The library is huge, containing lots of books of your liking and course materials. Hostels are compulsory. Hostel rooms are quite large and well-furnished, with the facility of a lift. There is a mess inside the hostel which is pure vegetarian, and a common mess outside the hostel. The mess menu is dec...

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS rishikesh, B.Sc.  (h) nursing .
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure is quite good. Wi-Fi is available in the college and hospital but not in the hostel. The campus is quite huge with a lot of greenery, including facilities for a gym, tennis court, volleyball, basketball, and badminton courts. The library is also present inside the hospital area in the academic block.

reviews.review_heading: The college of nursing AIIMS rishikesh review!
reviews.review_text: Being an AIIMS, the facilities here are top-notch with fully furnished hostels and all types of sports complexes, including a gym. Hostel rooms are shared for the first three years, with single rooms for final-year students. They have a huge library with all academic and non-academic books. The nursing mess is in the nursing hostel, but you also have access to Nescafe and the common mess.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with AIIMS Rishikesh and its weather, campus and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: In AIIMS Rishikesh, a B.Sc. nursing college, the campus is quite huge, as are our college and classrooms. We also have Wi-Fi facilities in hospital and colleges. We got various labs such as anatomy labs, central library, physiology lab, biochemistry lab, pathology lab, etc. According to the monthly mess, we get delicious food with desserts and we have canteen facilities in campus as well as in hospital. We have tennis court, badminton court cricket ground, football ground, table tennis, basketba...

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS Rishikesh: A hidden gem among AIIMS.
reviews.review_text: The AIIMS Campus consists of 3 diamond-shaped buildings connected to each other, with one more building being built at present. One of them is the college building, consisting of 6 floors, each with 2 to 3 departments and on the 5th floor, a surprisingly big library that is open 24/7, even on festivals so you can study at your own pace if you want. Each floor also has 1 lecture hall with enough ACs to keep you warm during the summer and heaters during the winter as the temperature in Rishikesh g...

reviews.review_heading: My MBBS from the AIIMS Rishikesh.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS Rishikesh has a very good infrastructure for the MBBS Course. Proper labs and medical facilities were available for the student's learning. The college has Wi-Fi, a library, canteens and sports facilities for the students. Hostel facility was offered to the students. Hostel rooms were furnished and big enough. Mess food was good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Best College in India is AIIMS.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides hostel facilities. Infrastructure is shiny. Our department has facilities such as internet connection, and a library with vast number of books. The canteen’s food is good. Mess also provides good food. Many games can be played here.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with the facilities available here at AIIMS RISHIKESH.
reviews.review_text: All the lecture theatres are modernized and centrally air conditioned with Wi-Fi facilities and all modern facilities. For library, we have a central library with access to all the Editorial, Research and Journal across the globe. Mess and canteen are hygienic and up to the mark. In sports we have cricket, soccer, kabaddi, lawn tennis, table tennis, badminton, chess, pool, snooker, basketball and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is beautiful and clean.
reviews.review_text: Our college is Wi-Fi enabled and is fully air-conditioned. Classrooms are well-built and equipped with projectors for the smooth conduction of classes. The library is huge. The hostel facility is good. The food served in the canteen and mess is good. Our college provides medical facilities whenever needed.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good campus, infrastructure, highly qualified professors, and a huge library.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories, classrooms, and library are air-conditioned. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The library of our college is huge with different sections like a reading room in which we can do group studies.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS in the Himalayas is a surreal experience.
reviews.review_text: The college architecture is state-of-the-art, with central air conditioning, central Wi-Fi, and a library with access to international online journals and sources. There are skill labs to learn various clinical procedures and practices. The hostels are nice, with single rooms, clean washrooms, and no electricity problems. There is no problem with modification as well.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, good clinical exposure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, the lecture theatre is modern and equipped with every basic necessity and more. Labs are equipped with good specimen and other high tech machines. Hostels have running water and electricity for 24 hours and 7 days. Hostels are kept clean.

reviews.review_heading: Review of AIIMS Rishikesh - All India Institute of Medical Sciences.
reviews.review_text: The whole college building is provided with a central air-conditioner. There is free Wi-Fi and hostels are fully furnished with no charge for living or electricity. Every sport is played and appreciated by the students. Enough sports items are provided by government funds. We are organising the biggest intercollegiate fest in Uttarakhand.
