overview_faqs.question: Is SOA University a good university?
overview_faqs.answer: SOA is one of the top private universities in Bhubaneswar, India. It is allotted a band rank of 1201-1400 by the QS World University Rankings 2025. The NIRF 2022 ranked SOA University in 16th position. SOA University has been continuously ranked among the top 20 Universities in India by NIRF. SOA is approved by the UGC and accredited by NAAC, ABET, and NBA. It is also recognised by the Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO). The SOA University's placement drive for the batch graduating in 2022 has been successfully completed. According to the most recent data, INR 42 LPA was the highest salary package provided during the 2022 placement drive. Students from SOA University's numerous programmes, including B.Tech, MBA, MCA and BDS among others, received favourable offers from reputable businesses during the placement drive for 2022.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee structure of SOA University?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

review_summary.college_name: SOA University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, okay placement.

content.Placements: There are many students in our batch. In our institute, the highest package was about 12 LPA. Our top recruiting companies are Dell, Wipro, TCS, etc. In our institution, many of the students were hired by TCS and WIPRO. All types of roles are available.
content.Infrastructure: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.

content.Placements: In this college, the placement rate is above 85%. The top companies are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, Cognizant, Dell, And Flipkart (which comes once this year), etc. The average package is 6 to 7 LPA. Recently, Accenture conducted mass recruitment, taking 300 candidates from ITER and providing packages of 12 LPA to around 77 students of the final year. Generally, companies come for placements around the 5th semester and continue to the last semester. Good, but not like KIIT, Odisha.
content.Infrastructure: In the case of the hostel, the fees are 1,10,000 for 1 year, and according to it, the food is good in quality and quantity. The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organized, like robotics camps, the SOA Cup, and many more. It deserves a 5-star rating.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I chose the best inter for real.

content.Placements: If you study, then you will one hundred percent get a job in our college. 90 percent of students are placed. The average package is 5 LPA. Meanwhile, the highest package is 42 LPA according to current data from Amazon, Infosys, etc top companies visit here.
content.Infrastructure: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.

content.Placements: 85 to 90 percent students are placed in my course. Out of these students, 35 to 40 percent students are in a specialisation course. The highest Package offered is 46 LPA, the average package 6 to 6.5 LPA, the lowest Package offered is 3.3 to 3.5 LPA. High paying recruiters are Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, PwC, Informatica, ServiceNow, Zscaler, Yugabyte. Mass Recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant GenC/Next, Capgemini, Accenture, and DXC Technology. 60 to 70 percent of students secure internships. Top Roles offered are Software Development Engineer SDE, System Engineer or Analyst, Full Stack Developer, Cloud Support Engineer, Data Analyst or Consultant, and Quality Assurance QA Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.

content.Placements: My college placements are average. Many companies come to our college, but pick very few students every year. Though the college claims 100% placements, that's not the case. Many of my seniors are struggling to get jobs. Academics are good but lack in extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

faqs.question: What is the total fees of SOA BTech programme?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech programme at SOA University ranges between INR 5.1 Lakhs - INR 11 lakhs. This range of fees does not include the cost of the mess or the hostel fee. There is a range in the fee structure because the fee for each specialisation can be slightly different from the other. The BTech programme at SOA University is also provided as a three-year lateral entry programme and in this case, the candidates will not have to pay for the first year of the prgramme. The fee mentioned here is taken from unofficial sources and can be indicative.

A:    Yes, there are seat reservations available at the Madras Medical College, Chennai. The seat reservation categories are as follows:

faqs.question: Are there any seat reservations at the Madras Medical College, Chennai?

faqs.answer: A:    Madras Medical College, Chennai requires NEET scores for admission to the MBBS program. NEET is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to medical courses in India. Therefore, it is mandatory for candidates to qualify for the NEET exam to be eligible for admission to the MBBS programme at Madras Medical College.
faqs.question: Can I join Madras Medical College, Chennai without NEET?

faqs.answer: A:    A significant number of applicants compete for a limited number of seats in government medical colleges under the All India quota based on NEET exam, making admission extremely competitive.For General AI category, the cutoffs are substantially higher than the cutoff for other All India quota seats. A considerably higher score—often in the range of 650–700 or more out of 720—is typically needed to be eligible for a place in a government medical college through the All India quota.A candidate who scores only 2–4 marks above the cutoff is likely to enter a highly competitive zone where their prospects of getting an All India quota seat are unpredictable and dependent on a number of variables, including the distribution of their overall score and the number of seats available.The number of candidates taking the NEET exam has a direct effect on the cut-off as well. A big candidate pool raises the level of competition and could result in higher cutoffs. The cut-off scores are impacted by the number of seats available in medical colleges.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Pharmacology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best for being a successful doctor.

content.Placements: 100 percent of students got placed here. There is no highest or lowest package, all got an average of 35 LPA. First of all, we get placement on our campus only, then if anyone wants, they can go for outside campus. 100 percent of students got internships from our course. Top roles are doctor, assistant doctor, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in our course include speed Wi-Fi and fully equipped labs, meaning everything is present. Fully air-conditioned classrooms with 30 students in each classroom. The hostel facility is very good. Food quality is very good, and food is given in unlimited quantities. Sports and games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Pharmacology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty members and placements, etc.

content.Placements: Around 90% students are placed with their internship. Highest package was between 15-20 LPA, average package was around 10-12 LPA, and lowest package was 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies that offered jobs are Pfizer, Novartis, Cipla, etc. Top roles offered are medical advisory, clinical research associate, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are outdated, and campus is spread over 10 acres. Wi-Fi, classroom, labs, and a well-stocked library are available on campus. Quality of food is good, and separate hostels are available for girls and boys. Outdoor and indoor games also occurred on campus.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Pharmacology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent college with good learning, but it needs improvement in facilities.

content.Placements: My batch is MD in Pharmacology from Madras Medical College. Around 30-40% of students got placed from our course. The highest package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package ranges from 4-5 LPA. The average package ranges between 6-8 LPA. Some top companies that come for recruitment are government research labs, pharma companies like Cipla, Sun Pharma, and some hospitals too. Almost 60-70% of students got internships. Most of them did internships in government hospitals, research centers, and a few in private pharma companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has classrooms, labs, and the library. Labs are okay and not very modern, but they are useful for study. Wi-Fi is there, but it is sometimes slow or does not work properly. The library has many books, but they are all a little old. Hostel facility is available. Rooms are okay, not very clean, but livable.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Pharmacology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I like the appreciation of extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: Internship period of 12 months where you will be given rupees 25000 per month during your internship period. You can learn all the basics of dentistry, and you are allowed to attend public camps regarding dental health programs conducted by the college itself. They offer an internship in my college hospital itself. It has so many allied institutions like Regional Institute of Ophthalmology RIO, Institute of Mental Health IMH, etc. They offer an internship there at CRRI.
content.Infrastructure: There will be inter-college sports meet and inter-college cultural meet, and they will also allow you for intra-college completion. There is sports coordinator here who will genuinely guide you and appreciate you. Every year, there will be sports GDC events in which all batches from final year to first year will participate and medals and an honor certificate will be given to all those winners on Republic Day. There will be interesting college and cultural events.

individual_reviews.course: MS in Orthopaedics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Girls-boys ratio is nearly 7:3. Hostel is available for both girls and boys.

content.Placements: There is no stipend provided for this course. We have visited so many institutions like Kilpauk, Apollo, Egmore, etc. They conduct research for the students in the hospital according to their subjects. Internship is compulsory in the same college for 1 year salary will be provided by the institution itself. In every department, there is particular time period to work and we need to complete that to graduate.
content.Infrastructure: Actually, every book that is needed for the course is plenty in the library including journals, magazines, and so on. Classes will be held only by the projector technique. Sometimes it will be with visual, audio, and audio-visual aids. Mostly there is no extra care in sports but competitions will be held.

faqs.question: Are there any seat reservations at the Madras Medical College, Chennai?
faqs.answer:
Yes, there are seat reservations available at the Madras Medical College, Chennai. The seat reservation categories are as follows:
85 percent of seats in the MBBS course are reserved for the students who are natives of Tamil Nadu under State Quota. At the time of admission in Government Medical Colleges and Self-Financing Medical Colleges,  85 percent of the total available seats are reserved for students of Tamil Nadu only. Students applying under special Categories and Sports Quota need to submit a separate form in support of their candidature along with an additional fee of INR 100. Open Category Reservation: 31 percent
Backward Class Reservation: 26.5 percent
Backward Class (Muslim) Reservation: 3.5 percent
Most Backward Class Reservation: 20 percent
Scheduled Caste Reservation: 02 percent
Arunthathiyar Community Reservation: 16 percent
Scheduled Tribe Reservation: 1 percent
There are also seats reserved for students with disabilities and children of ex-servicemen.

faqs.question: What impact does the number of available seats have on NEET 2024 cut-offs?
faqs.answer: A significant number of applicants compete for a limited number of seats in government medical colleges under the All India quota based on NEET exam, making admission extremely competitive.For General AI category, the cutoffs are substantially higher than the cutoff for other All India quota seats. A considerably higher score—often in the range of 650–700 or more out of 720—is typically needed to be eligible for a place in a government medical college through the All India quota.A candidate who scores only 2–4 marks above the cutoff is likely to enter a highly competitive zone where their prospects of getting an All India quota seat are unpredictable and dependent on a number of variables, including the distribution of their overall score and the number of seats available.The number of candidates taking the NEET exam has a direct effect on the cut-off as well. faqs.question: Is there any government job that I can get after completing MPH at SCTIMST Trivandrum?
faqs.answer: Yes, besides the private sector jobs, the career opportunities after pursuing an MPH include various government jobs as well. After graduating with an MPH degree from SCTIMST Trivandrum, students can build a career in the fields of public health administration, epidemiology, health policy, and health education. They can work with organisations like the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Health Mission, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), and State Public Health Departments. Some famous job roles may include public health officers, health policy analysts, epidemiologists, health programme managers, researchers, etc.

faqs.question: Does SCTIMST Trivandrum offer 100% placements to MPH students?

Earlier, the placement rate during SCTIMST Trivandrum PG (2-year) placements in 2021 and 2020 was 87% and 93%, respectively. Hence, the institute may not have a placemet rate of 100% but has maintained a notable placement rate of over 80% for PG (2-year) courses.

overview_faqs.question: Is MBBS available in SRM Medical College?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, SRM Medical College offers MBBS course at the UG level. This course is offered for a duration of four and half years with one year of compulsory rotating internship. The total seat intake for this course is 250. The seats for MBBS course is filled via scores obtained in the NEET UG entrance exam. Candidates seeking for admission to this course are required to pass Class 12 with Science stream and qualify for NEET UG exam with a valid score. The curriculum of this course covers subjects such as Anatomy, Sugery, Medicine, Forensic Medicine, Physiology, etc.

overview_faqs.question: What is the course fee of MBBS programme at SRM Medical College?
overview_faqs.answer: As per the course fee details mentioned on the official website of SRM Medical College for the MBBS course, the annual fee for the course is INR 25 lakh. Candidates also have to pay a registration amount of INR 10,000 in the first year only. Futher, the accommodation charges are separate for boys and girls. Students who get selected via the NEET UG counselling process have to pay a certain amount of fee at the time of physical reporting to lock their seat.

individual_reviews.title: Overall 4 years in SRM was very good. I passed out with a good CGPA.

content.Placements: I got selected in 2 placement interviews conducted in the college. So placement interviews do happen. individual_reviews.title: Actually, it is a good college with an excellent campus and placements.

content.Placements: Students must pass an entrance exam conducted by the university. If they pass, they will be selected. Admission to all medical courses is done through valid scores of national-level entrance for the respective courses. Interested students can see the below-mentioned guide to complete theSRM Medical College admission process:
1: SRM Medical College Application Process 2025

Aspirants seeking admission to the medical programmes offered by SRM Medical College course admission must apply on the official website of the respective entrance exam. Once the results are out, students can apply for SRM Medical College through the MCI counselling. For the remaining programmes, the application can be completed through the institute’s official website.
2: SRM Medical College Selection Rounds

Admission to MBBS, MD/MS and DM/ MCh is based on scores of NEET UG, NEET PG and NEET SS, respectively. Later on, the shortlisted candidates will be allocated seats through a counselling process. For Health Science courses, seats are offered based on the academic merit of the student.
3: Counselling Process

All the NEET qualifiers have to register for the counselling process conducted by the MCC of DGHS on the official website of the conducting body and pay the registration fee and a refundable security deposit. During the choice filling for Round 1, candidates have to select SRM Medical College and choose their desired course with specialisation. Further, round-wise merit lists will be released on the official website of MCC. Candidates who manage to secure a seat in Round 1 can proceed with the process, whereas the remaining candidates have to appear for other counselling rounds such as Round 2, Mop-up Round and Stray Vacancy Round.
4: Physical Reporting & Documents Verification

Candidates who are allocated seats need to download their allotment letter and report at SRM Medical College in person for the document verification process and fee payment to lock their seats within the stipulated timeline.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in SRM Medical College?
faqs.answer: SRM Medical College does not accept direct admissions to any of its programmes. Students must either qualify for the entrance (if applicable) or clear the eligibility to get selected. SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre accept students on an entrance basis for some of its programmes, such as MBBS and MD/MD. To get into those courses, students must appear and clear the NEET exam and participate in the counselling conducted by MCI. However, Health Science course admissions are subject to fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. Students are selected based on their overall academic performance and the availability of seats. Students can contact the admission help desk of the institute to know further.

faqs.question: Are admissions open in SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre?
faqs.answer: Yes, admissions for the MBBS course in SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre are open. The application process for the MBBS course begins in October and closes in December. The selection process for the MBBS course is based on the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) score.The NEET is a national-level entrance exam for medical and dental colleges in India. The exam is held once a year in May. To be eligible for the NEET, candidates must have passed the 12th standard with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as compulsory subjects.

faqs.question: What are the selection criteria for SRM Medical College MBBS admission?
faqs.answer: The students are selected forMBBSadmission in SRM Medical College based on their NEET score and NEET counselling. A NEET-qualified candidate is eligible to register for AIQ counselling and its subsequent rounds, at the official website of MCC. A merit list is then released on the same website and the candidates who have cleared the required cut-off for SRM Medical College MBBS are selected for admission.

faqs.question: Is internship a compulsory part of MBBS course of SRM?
faqs.answer: Yes, the students of MBBS at SRM Medical College are required to pursue a one-year internship , in addition to the course period of 4.5 years, as prescribed by the NMC. Hence, the total course period becomes 5.5 years for MBBS students. In this one-year compulsory internship, students gain practical experience in patient care, diagnostics, treatment and management under the supervision of experienced doctors and healthcare professionals. A stipend of INR 13,500 per month is also paid to the MBBS interns at SRM Medical College.

faqs.question: What is the average package for B.Sc students at SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre?
faqs.answer: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre: Placement package Placements: Students receive the abundance of the practical experience via internships at the SRM Medical Hospitals, that starts from forth-year on. The figure is beyond 70% in terms of placements, and the average starting salary comes up to the figure of 3.5 Lacs per annum, whereas the highest is 15 Lacs per annum. Being directed by public hospitals and clinics, companies may not appoint a large number of graduates, but graduates are often capable of maneuvering themselves into highly ranked positions such as Senior Consultant.

review_content.Placements: In the MBBS course, placements aren't structured like in engineering; it's more about internships and residency. The university offers various courses, such as BTech, BSc, MSc, BBA, MBA and many others under various schools, including Allied Science, Nursing, Engineering and Technology and many others. Candidates are required to meet the eligibility criteria set by the university to be eligible for admission. Candidates get entrance-based admission to all UG, PG and diploma courses.DMIHERcarries out the application process in both online and offline modes. Read the following article to get a detailed breakdown of Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education & Research admission, course eligibility, selection criteria and admission process:

Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education & Research admission to all its courses is both merit and entrance-based. Applicants can register for admission at the college by visiting their website. Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education & Research admission process 2025 has begun for all courses. The university offers entrance-based admission to all the courses. Candidates are required to fulfil the admission process of DMIHER for admission. Check below the DMIHER admission process 2025:
Step 1:Application Process 2025
Candidates searching for admission to DMIHER in any course are required to apply on the official website of DMIHER .
Step 2: Selection Rounds

DMIHER admission is entrance-based for all the courses. The university offers various national-level and state-level entrance exam scores for admission to its UG, PG and diploma courses. Additionaly. Candidates are required to fill out the eligibility criteria i.e., pass Class 12 for admission to UG courses, pass UG degree for admission to PG courses.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment/Fee Submission

DMIHER releases the merit list based on the scores in qualifying entrance exams. Candidates who get shortlisted in the selection round are required to submit a certain amount of fee to lock their seats.

faqs.question: Is pursuing MBA at Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research expensive?
faqs.answer: DMIHER Online’s courses are relatively affordable. The MBA programme is offered by DMIMS through its affiliated institute Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research (DMIHER), which is available online. The fee for the MBA will be around Rs. 2,20,000 per annum, which is low compared to other colleges in the vicinity. The college may also charge a registration fee of Rs. 5,000. The fee for the MBA only includes the tuition fees. The college may charge additional fees for hostel, examination, placement, etc. Contact the admissions office of DMIHER to find out about the availability and fees of on-campus MBA programs. It would be better to research the MBA programme fees of other universities in your vicinity or in your preferred location.

faqs.question: What is the fees for MCA at Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research?
faqs.answer: Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research MCA fee is about 90,000 annually and for 2 years it is about 1,80,000. DMIHER's on-campus MCA fee is not available on its official website. You can contact the admissions office for more information. You should have a bachelor's degree in computer Science or computer applications with a minimum of 50% marks and should have Maths in 12th grade. The programme focuses on the development and implementation of practical information system applications and provides a basic grounding in the fundamentals of computer science. Email or phone the admissions office for the latest information on MCA on campus and MCA fees.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, DMIHER outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 13 ranks to #84 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, DMIHER fell 7 ranks to #49 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'Medical' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER climbed 3 ranks to #20 rank in the 'Medical' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
The institute's ranks in the 'Dental' category; have descended when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 12 ranks to #36 rank in the 'Dental' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

reviews.review_heading: Honestly, the college is excellent, you should really prefer this college as your top priority.
reviews.review_text: Datta Meghe of the College of Pharmacy has great facilities and infrastructure. They provide Wi-Fi and library access to all students. Hostel has a great environment and a chill area. The mess is very clean, and they maintain hygiene. Overall, the college is best for your career.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The college provides hostel facilities in collaboration with the PG hostel. My hostel fee is 2.10 lakhs, 1.8 lakhs for rent, and Rs. 30,000 for amenities for non-AC, and for AC, it is extra. Mess charge for me is Rs. 42,000. Rooms are on a double-sharing basis. Good food is provided. We have good facilities here.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and a good hospital.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with AC, and the library is also very good. The quality of food is good, but our mess provides only vegetarian food. The medical facilities are free for students studying in the college. There are grounds available for sports.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college and I got knowledge about the laboratory field.

Projectors are available in all classrooms. All facilities are available in our classrooms. The hostel facility is available. They provide food.

reviews.review_heading: It's All About DMIHER Life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good coaching and clean college.

content.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students from our course were placed through campus recruitment drives. Highest package is 20 LPA. Lowest package is 5 LPA. Around 70%-75% of students secure an internship through campus drives. Top roles offered are software development engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel has clean and well-maintained rooms, a common study hall, and a 24/7 water and electricity supply. Mess provides balanced diet food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports. Medical, 24/7 ambulance service.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure with supportive faculty and good placements.

content.Placements: I am part of the 2024 to 2028 batch. My seniors who passed away from this college received many packages mentioned below. Placement Percentage around 80 to 90% of students are placed from our course. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, HCL, and a few product based companies. Internship Opportunities Nearly 70 to 80% of students got internships, often in companies like TCS, Infosys, Startups, and local IT firms, which provided good exposure. The major roles offered are Software Developer, Analyst, Associate Engineer, System Engineer, Data Analyst, and Support Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Information about Sri Ramachandra life.

content.Placements: Our college offers 100% placements to eligible students. The average package offered is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. The college has a dedicated placement team. The college organizes on-campus events to help students find jobs and internships. The college has a strong placement network.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the largest medical libraries in the region, and collaborates with Harvard Medical International. It has a large collection of textbooks, journals, and more. We also have modern laboratories. It also exercises physiology labs with metabolic analyzers, treadmills, and more. There is a sports biomechanics lab with 3D cameras, forceplates, and more. We have a podiatry lab with foot pressure analysis systems. There is an anthropometry lab with stadiometers and more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Microbiology and Applied Molecular Biology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sriher a glimpse. Absolutely good infrastructure and social life. The faculty is very friendly.

content.Placements: Our course doesn't have placement arrangements. So I have no idea about it. I don't know what I should say about this topic. But our college does provide a 6-month internship programme within the campus to have hands-on experience with everything we have learnt in these years.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available are top-notch. There are no compensations for infrastructure. All classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi connections, smart boards, projectors, etc. The library has a vast number of books about various fields of study and journals. The canteen facilities and medical facilities are good because they have their hospital set up as this is a medical college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: There are 250 students in one batch. For MBBS internships are only required in the final year after completion of the course. According to central lawns internships are in the same hospital as the study. After MBBS and internship, there are multiple opportunities to go abroad for further training, as well as opportunities to remain in India and pursue an MS or an MD. As for research, the faculty members are incredibly helpful and the university offers grants for students who wish to engage in research. The medical college is also recognised by the USA for further studies there.

admission_overview.title: Sri Ramachandra University Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Sri Ramachandra University admission 2025 is entrance-based for some of the courses and merit-based for others. The university considers scores of NEET-UG, NEET MDS, etc. for admission to specififc programmes. SRIHER also conducts its own entrance test to shortlist aspirants for UG and PG courses. The deemed-to-be university offers over 50 courses at UG, PG, and PhD levels through nine faculties. The courses are offered in various streams, including Dental Science, Biomedical Science, Allied Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Management, etc. Additionally, SRIHER also provides scholarships to meritorious students.

eligibility_selection.title: Sri Ramachandra University Eligibility & Selection 2025
eligibility_selection.description: Admission at SRIHER is entrance-based. It is also important that the students meet the eligibility criteria. The general eligibility for UG courses is class 12 pass, and for PG courses is graduation. The table below showcases the eligibility and selection criteria for SRIHER courses:

courses_table.eligibility: Class 12 or equivalent with a minimum 60% marks and Mathematics, Physics as compulsory, Chemistry, Computer Science, Biology and any other eligible subjects
A pass in any UG degree with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST) from any recognised university.
courses_table.selection_criteria: MAT/ CMAT/ XAT/ CAT/ SRIHER MBA Entrance Exam

courses_table.eligibility: Class 12 or equivalent with a minimum 55% marks and Mathematics, Physics as compulsory, Chemistry, Computer Science, Biology and any other eligible subjects

Graduation in Computers, Engineering, Science, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences, Business, Commerce and others with a minimum of 55% marks Working professionals in relevant fields are also eligible

Candidates must have passed the HSC examination /equivalent examination with a minimum of 50% aggregate (40% aggregate for SC/ ST/ OBC) taking together Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or Botany & Zoology) and a pass in English. Aspirants have also secured not less than 50% marks (40% marks for SC/ ST/ OBC) in the entrance exam to apply for the MBBS course.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best medical colleges in India.

reviews_list.batch_info: Diploma in Radiography - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of no placement system like engineering colleges.

review_content.Placements: After 12th board from Science background, one have to appear in entrance exam conducted by state medical faculty of west Bengal. You have to secure good score or rank in the exam to get admission in government medical colleges. There are total 13 departments and Radiography is one of them. In my department, there are 35 seats for one year in our departments. Two years Diploma course with 6 month internship, total duration 2.5 years. Only 2000 per month stipend is provided during internship period. After passing out, you have to find your job by yourself. There is no campusing system like engineering. IPGMER is a most popular institution in Bengal, so students of this institution get priority in private hospitals for jobs. The Salaries is not much in this field. There are only 15-20k per month is given in private sector to freshers.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: It is one of the best colleges in India.

review_content.Placements: Internships are compulsory in our college. The stipend offered is Rs.20,000 per month.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have two carrom boards and two table tennis boards. It also provides a small playground. Hostel facilities are good, and elevator is also available. Hostel provides facilities like a fire control system, cameras, 24X7 water supply, and a canteen. There is a good security guard as well. The washrooms are clean.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members are average in our college. Some of them use powerpoint presentations to teach properly. Our course curriculum is old. MCI syllabus is good for our juniors. The semester exams are not good. There should be more practical intelligence-based questions than outdated questions.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Perfusion Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Perfusion technology in IPGME&R and SSKMH - A beautiful journey .

content.Placements: All the students from our course were placed. 15k per month was the lowest package, and 30k per month with lodging and food was the highest. Students were recruited at reputed institutes like R.N. Tagore, CMRI, and Apollo Hospital, where cardiac surgery is performed. All students get to do an internship at the college and get approximately 10k per month as a stipend during the internship. Though you get a degree as a perfusionist, you can also be offered roles like critical care technologist and operation theatre technologist.
content.Infrastructure: We have a well-equipped lecture theatre with projectors, computers, AC, green boards, speakers, and microphones. There is also a dissection hall and other practical rooms where you can gain experience in your practical work. You also get to work in a real cardiac ICU and OT. You get great exposure. There are four canteens and many other fast-food stores on campus. We have fields where you can play cricket, soccer, or badminton. A gym is also available. There is a central library, and we also have an in-department library. However, a hostel is not offered for our course.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 100% students get placement after completing. The lowest package is 480000 per year (monthly 40000). The highest package is 70,000 per month (if you apply for a medical officer). Income may vary. The internship is offered by the college and mandatory to get a degree. Internship duration is 12 months. Payment during internship: 32000 per month. Roles offered are housestaffship, medical officer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Library: for access of medical students, free, adjacent student study room. Classrooms: air conditioning, use of projectors, etc. Wi-Fi facilities are available on campus and in the library. Hostel rooms are decent, Wi-Fi, gym facilities, etc. Food quality is really good and there is more than one canteen.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Radiography - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of no placement system like engineering colleges.

content.Placements: After 12th board from Science background, one have to appear in entrance exam conducted by state medical faculty of west Bengal. You have to secure good score or rank in the exam to get admission in government medical colleges. There are total 13 departments and Radiography is one of them. In my department, there are 35 seats for one year in our departments. Two years Diploma course with 6 month internship, total duration 2.5 years. Only 2000 per month stipend is provided during internship period. After passing out, you have to find your job by yourself. There is no campusing system like engineering. IPGMER is a most popular institution in Bengal, so students of this institution get priority in private hospitals for jobs. The Salaries is not much in this field. There are only 15-20k per month is given in private sector to freshers.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is one of the best colleges in India.

content.Placements: Internships are compulsory in our college. The stipend offered is Rs.20,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: We have two carrom boards and two table tennis boards. It also provides a small playground. Hostel facilities are good, and elevator is also available. Hostel provides facilities like a fire control system, cameras, 24X7 water supply, and a canteen. There is a good security guard as well. The washrooms are clean.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are average in our college. Some of them use powerpoint presentations to teach properly. Our course curriculum is old. MCI syllabus is good for our juniors. The semester exams are not good. There should be more practical intelligence-based questions than outdated questions.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Perfusion Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely right college for Medical. Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: No placement records are required for a medical background. Everything is dependent on your ability. As you are aware, it is one of the best hospitals in the world. If you're going to an interview and you're from the Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research, this will be great for you.
content.Infrastructure: There are top medical faculty members at the Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research. You can connect to free Wi-Fi. Each and every department has its own laboratory. There is central library. There is good food and a mess available.

review_content.Placements: Almost 100% of students will get placement as doctors. The salary package varies according to the next qualification pursued. For example, a non-academic Junior President (JR) is expected to earn around Rs. 90,000-1 lakh, while academic JRs earn around 1.1 lakh -1.2 lakh. review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are excellent compared to state government colleges (some even offer charging ports). Library has free Wi-Fi, and labs are well-equipped. reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with my college life and I have a secure career in AIIMS.

review_content.Placements: Students get a stipend of Rs. 9,500 every month for their clinical duties in the hospital. The full-year course price in AIIMS is approximately 93000 to 94000. The Mess Fee is included separately every month. After the completion of their final year, students are supposed to do a 6-month internship at that particular college. It is compulsory for all students in the final year. They get paid 13,000 per month during their internship period. After this, the students can opt for either NORCET for becoming a nursing officer or the M.Sc. entrance exam for a teaching career.

It is one of the reputed Nursing courses in India.Students enrolled in this course develop proficiency in core competencies like patient-based care, professionalism, communication and teamwork, safety, evidence-based practice, and leadership. Candidates seeking admission must appear for the AIIMS Paramedical Exam.

overview_faqs.question: What is the application fee for the MBBS programme at AIIMS Bhopal?
overview_faqs.answer: To be admitted to AIIMS Bhopal's MBBS curriculum, applicants must pass the All India Medical Test for Undergraduates (NEET). The NEET form fees are INR 1,700 for General/NRI students, INR 1,600 for EWS/OBC candidates, and INR 1,000 for candidates in reserved categories, according to the official booklet. Only online payments will be accepted for the NEET exam fees in 2024. In addition you can check the official website.

overview_faqs.question: How is MS in Orthopaedics at AIIMS Bhopal?
overview_faqs.answer: MS in Orthopaedics at AIIMS Bhopal is a 3 years course at the PG level. The course offers admission to 4 students. The total tuition fee structure for AIIMS Bhopal MS in Orthopaedics is INR 2,106. Apart from the tuition fee, there is a one-time admission fee of amount INR 125, and a hostel fee of amount INR 17,920 that students are required to pay in addition to the tuition fee. To get admitted to AIIMS Bhopal MS in Orthopaedics course, applicants must meet the entry requirements - 55% in graduation. The median salary package offered is around INR 1 LPA.

review_summary.college_name: AIIMS Bhopal Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: AIIMS Bhopal: A Student's Insight.

content.Placements: We are pursuing MBBS, so we don't get placed in a company as such, but most of our college students get a good rank in the entrance exam, which is supposed to be given for entering into post-graduation. The best rank of our college is AIR 30, and our seniors are in top medical colleges like AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, etc., pursuing PG in their dream branches.
content.Infrastructure: We have the best-in-class hostel facilities. We are provided with a single room right from the day one, with full opportunity for all the modifications we can think of, be it putting AC in your room or having a refrigerator. The hostel has free Wi-Fi on all floors, and the washrooms are also clean. Overall, it is way too good than my expectations. Our classrooms are well-equipped and are up to the mark. Our campus is also full of facilities like gym, badminton court, basketball court, football court, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: AIIMS Bhopal is one of the best medical colleges in India.

content.Placements: Currently our batch MBBS 2021 is in the 3rd year of college, which is the 6th semester. We will be doing an internship in our own college, AIIMS Bhopal, after 1.5 years from now after passing the final year. We get a pretty good stipend of about 30,000 per month. Most of the people passing from our colleges get a very good college in post-graduation studies.
content.Infrastructure: AIIMS Bhopal has one of the best infrastructures among medical colleges in India. We have a pretty big campus of around 150 acres of land. Our hospital is quite big and well designed. We have a decent college building consisting of 6 lecture theaters, of which 2 are newly built, and they are very big. We have separate hostels for both boys and girls, with each student getting a single room from the first year itself.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: AIIMS Bhopal - More than you think.

content.Placements: Almost 100% of students will get placement as doctors. The salary package varies according to the next qualification pursued. For example, a non-academic Junior President (JR) is expected to earn around Rs. 90,000-1 lakh, while academic JRs earn around 1.1 lakh -1.2 lakh. Everything depends on whether students can crack NEET PG/INICET.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are excellent compared to state government colleges (some even offer charging ports). Library has free Wi-Fi, and labs are well-equipped. Single occupancy rooms and lifts are available in hostels. Food is average. Tennis, basketball, and football grounds are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college life and I have a secure career in AIIMS.

content.Placements: Students get a stipend of Rs. 9,500 every month for their clinical duties in the hospital. The full-year course price in AIIMS is approximately 93000 to 94000. The Mess Fee is included separately every month. After the completion of their final year, students are supposed to do a 6-month internship at that particular college. It is compulsory for all students in the final year. They get paid 13,000 per month during their internship period. After this, the students can opt for either NORCET for becoming a nursing officer or the M.Sc. entrance exam for a teaching career.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: AIIMS Bhopal is one of the India's best Medical College and Hospital.

content.Placements: Every student of AIIMS becomes a doctor. Students get best clinical education, then great experience in clinical practice during clinical postings and internship which help a lot in Hospital management, patient care, Diagnosis.
content.Infrastructure: Library and classroom well maintained, proper ventilated, good environment for study. Mess food is of decent quality, clean drinking water, football ground, tennis court, basketball court present. Canteen present in hospital and small snack, coffee centre at places inside campus present.

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS Bhopal: A Student's Insight.
reviews.review_text: We have the best-in-class hostel facilities. We are provided with a single room right from the day one, with full opportunity for all the modifications we can think of, be it putting AC in your room or having a refrigerator. The hostel has free Wi-Fi on all floors, and the washrooms are also clean. Overall, it is way too good than my expectations. Our classrooms are well-equipped and are up to the mark. Our campus is also full of facilities like gym, badminton court, basketball court, football c...

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS Bhopal is one of the best medical colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS Bhopal has one of the best infrastructures among medical colleges in India. We have a pretty big campus of around 150 acres of land. Our hospital is quite big and well designed. We have a decent college building consisting of 6 lecture theaters, of which 2 are newly built, and they are very big. We have separate hostels for both boys and girls, with each student getting a single room from the first year itself.

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS Bhopal - More than you think.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are excellent compared to state government colleges (some even offer charging ports). Library has free Wi-Fi, and labs are well-equipped. Single occupancy rooms and lifts are available in hostels. Food is average. Tennis, basketball, and football grounds are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with my college life and I have a secure career in AIIMS.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS Bhopal had a big infrastructure, including a medical college, a nursing college, auditorium, a library, AIIMS Hospital for Trauma Emergency, OPD and cancer treatment block, AYUSH DEPARTMENT, and hostels of UG and PG students of various courses. The college had great area for other entertaining activities, such as a huge campus including cricket field, basketball court, tennis court, gym, canteen, etc. The quality of food is average but sometimes good. Mess provides meal four times a day, i...

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS Bhopal is one of the India's best Medical College and Hospital.
reviews.review_text: Library and classroom well maintained, proper ventilated, good environment for study. Mess food is of decent quality, clean drinking water, football ground, tennis court, basketball court present. Canteen present in hospital and small snack, coffee centre at places inside campus present.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very nice green campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Lecture halls are well furnished and with digital boards plus green boards. The central library has a wide variety of books with awesome seating arrangements along with Wi-Fi and computer systems if required. Many labs are there in each department so you get your table and microscopes. You don't have to share it and the student cadaver ratio in 1st year is also good which is 12 students for 1 cadaver which is not very good in other institutes.

reviews.review_heading: I am little dissatisfied, average infrastructure, lack of tutors in college, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. But, the classes are not properly built. There are uncomfortable chairs instead of benches. Wi-Fi is not there in classrooms. In hostel, we deal with water supply issues, even for drinking water. Library is well arranged with air-conditioners and Wi-Fi. Mess is not good. Food quality is also not much good. Sports and games occur at intervals.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college to pursue MBBS. The architecture and senior-junior interaction are all perfect
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good here. In the past year, we have witnessed the building of a new boys' hostel as well as an improved lighting system. For now, barricades are in place for security reasons. A single central library is present here with all the facilities, and it is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best AIIMS after AIIMS Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are top-notch. The only problem is the non-availability of Wi-Fi in some hostels. Library is near the hostels, so students can go any time. It also provides free Wi-Fi for students with good speed. Nescafe canteen and a Maggi hotspot on the campus are pretty good in terms of food quality.

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS is the best place to create memories of the MBBS if you are a medico.
reviews.review_text: There is a world-class infrastructure here. There is a medical college, nursing college and AYUSH courses that are currently provided by the AIIMS Bhopal. In the future, there will be a provision for improvement in the infrastructure of the academic buildings. Hostels are very beautiful and clean.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best medical college in India.
reviews.review_text: The campus has pretty much all the games like football, badminton, basketball and volleyball grounds which students can use anytime. Apart from that, the proposed swimming pool is also under construction. An inter-college fest called Retina is organised every year with a whole array of cultural and sports activities and also celebrity nights. Labs are also well-equipped and spacious. Hostel infrastructure is awesome, and every student is allotted a single/individual room, which is sufficient for...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best medical college in Central India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and constantly improving. We get single rooms in the hostel, and the mess charges are nominal as well. Sports and academic architecture are constantly growing. We have two Nescafe outlets as well on our campus. The hospital is well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: Giving a gist of life at AIIMS Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch at AIIMS, being an institute of national importance. Single occupancy rooms are provided from the first year itself. The rooms are in pretty good condition and comfortable, with all amenities and furniture. Wi-Fi is available, and the food from the mess is okayish.

individual_reviews.title: Hostels are the worst part of our college.

content.Placements: In MBBS, there is nothing like a placement, but we do get a stipend of around Rs. 28,000, and after doing MBBS, if you land up in PG, then you can expect 1.2 LPA. It all depends on your efforts because the branch you will be pursuing will depend on your PG rank.

faqs.answer: The highest package offered at Maulana Azad Medical College, University of Delhi is approximately INR 80 LPA (80 Lacs per annum). Further, the placement rate recorded during Maulana Azad Medical College PG 2-year and PG 3-year placements in 2022 was 100 percent.

faqs.question: Does Maulana Azad Medical College, University of Delhi have good placements?
faqs.answer: Maulana Azad Medical College, University of Delhi, has good placements. The college has a placement rate of almost 100%. The average package is not less than INR 85,000 per month in Delhi and can go up to INR 1 Lacs or INR 2 Lacs per month after an undergraduate degree. The highest salary package offered was approximately INR 80 LPA. The college is highly ranked and prestigious, is recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI), and is affiliated with Delhi University.

college_info.intro:
AIIMS Patna offers various programmes at several levels such as UG, PG, etc. The programmes are offered across various fields including Medicine, Nursing, Medical, and others. MBBS is the flagship programme of AIIMS Patna. MBBS is offered for a duration of five and a half years. The aforementioned duration also includes one year of compulsory internship. During the internship period, students are given practical training to become successful health practitioners. The internship period also includes ward posting. After the successful completion of the MBBS programme, students could either pursue higher education such as MD, MS, etc., or can start their practice. All India Institute of Medical Sciences Patna offers internships at its attached hospital, i.e., AIIMS Hospital Patna.
AIIMS Patna also offers BSc and ANM courses. After completing the BSc Nursing course from the institute, students can become Home Care Nurses, Junior Psychiatric Nurses, Nursing Executives, and others. fees_and_eligibility.overview:
Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences admission 2025 for all the programmes is entrance-based. ILBS Delhi offers PDCC in 13 and PGCC in three specialisations with the duration of one year. It also offers DM in three, MCh and DNB in one specialisation each. The duration of all these programmes is three years. The deemed University invites PhD applications at doctorate level in three specialisations. Other than these, 11 short-term and three certificate programmes are additionally offered by ILBS Delhi. faqs.answer: A:    ILBS Delhi requires candidates to score a minimum of 50% marks in their entrance exam to qualify for admissions into the certificate courses offered by ILBS Delhi. The entrance exam is divided into 2 segments with the first one being an mcq based test of 100 questions which carries 70 marks and an interview with the admission department of the ILBS Delhi which carries 30 marks.
faqs.question: How much score do I need in the entrance exam to qualify for certificate admissions at ILBS Delhi?

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates should take into account a number of living and educational expenses while pursuing MCh. at ILBS Delhi. Students may still have to pay for books, clinical supplies, test fees, and housing even though the tuition may be less expensive than at many private universities. Candidates should evaluate the return on investment they are getting against their expenses from the institute.

placement_data.title: AMU Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: AMU Engineering and Management NIRF reports 2024, reports that the median package given to AMU BTech placements 2023 was INR 6 LPA , and for the MBA placements 2023, the median package stood at INR 5.26 LPA. With this the placement rate during Aligarh Muslim University placements 2023 for BTech was 82% and for MBA it was 84% .

Earlier, as per the media report, 5 students from the Faculties of Science, Life Science, Commerce and Engineering , Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) were selected by IB Global Academy , Gurugram as faculty members in the campus placement drive 2023. The highest package offered during AMU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 14 LPA. Earlier, according to media reports, 11 BTech students have been placed during AMU placements 2022. Further, the highest package offered during AMU BTech placements 2022 stood at INR 21 LPA. The top recruiters of Aligarh Muslim University in 2022 included leading companies such as Forbes Marshall, Publicis Sapient, and Ramboll India.

faqs.answer: St John's Medical College, Bangalore was established in 1963 by the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of India (CBCI). overview_faqs.question: What is St John Medical College famous for?
overview_faqs.answer: St John's Medical College, Bangalore was established in 1963 by the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of India (CBCI). The college is affiliated to the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Bangalore. St John’s National Academy of Health Sciences has been recognised by the NAAC and is approved by MCI, Government of Karnataka, the nursing college under it is recognised by Indian Nursing Council and Karnataka Nursing Council. The college has been ranked 19 by NIRF 2023 among the top Medical colleges in India with a score of 60.49. St John's Medical College offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Super Specialty, and Doctoral courses in the field of Medicine, Nursing, and Allied Health Sciences. St John's Medical College is popular for its MBBS course. Candidates can enrol in the MBBS course by taking the NEET exam.

overview_faqs.question: What are the fees at St John’s National Academy of Health Sciences?
overview_faqs.answer: St John's Medical College fees for the various courses is restricted to a fairly reasonable level. For instance, the total MBBS course tuition fees at the institute is INR 30 lakhs, while the BSc programs fees range between INR 90 thousands and 4.4 lakhs. Furthermore, the MD course would cost students between INR 3 Lacs and 33 lakhs, while the GNM fee is INR 1.1 lakhs.

individual_reviews.title: Dream college of every student.

content.Placements: Everyone gets placed in the form of bond service After course completion each one of us has to do bond service. Monthly 50000 to 100000 salary is given depending on hospitals. After four years of mbbs each one of us have to do one year of internship.
content.Infrastructure: Each department has separate classes with facilities. individual_reviews.course: Master in Hospital Administration (MHA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college was giving the best-quality placements to its students.

content.Placements: At John Medical College, students were getting good placement opportunities. Around 60% of the students get placed in our course. The average package offered at this college was between 8 and 12 LPA. The top recruiters were the various medical and hospital chains. At our college, 100% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a very good infrastructure. Our college has labs for the practical knowledge of the students. The college has Wi-Fi, a library, a canteen, a hostel, sports, etc. facilities for the students. The hostel facilities were of good quality. The food in the hostel mess was good to eat.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Feb 2023) - B.Sc. in Anesthesia Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has great placements, good infrastructure, a beautiful campus, a huge playground, etc.

content.Placements: They provide good placements with decent salary packages. St. John's National Academy of Health Sciences has its own hospital, which is very helpful for students to have regular exposure to patients and hospital life. It helps to gain experience and learn many things.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The campus is filled with greenery all over. Cleanliness is the first priority in the college, hospital, hostel, etc. We have a huge library, a study hall, and classrooms. There is a huge playground with separate facilities for cricket, football, volleyball, throwball, hockey, and tennis.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I had a great experience at St. John's National Academy of Health Sciences.

content.Placements: St. John's Medical College is very well-reputed. We have a compulsory rural bond where we are all given rural centers to work for. So, for the first two years, you have a guaranteed job. If you complete the bond, you have a reservation in the college for your PG. The stipend offered is about Rs.40,000 per month. Internship programs are good.
content.Infrastructure: We have an annual fest called Autumn Muse every year. We have arts and sports teams, and major sports include basketball, hockey, cricket, and volleyball. The library is huge and has almost all the books. It is air-conditioned. Hostels are clean and have all the required facilities. All the students are allotted rooms. Initially, double-sharing rooms are allotted, and later, single-occupancy rooms are allotted in the second year. All the necessary facilities are provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Fully satisfied because of the knowledge and clinical experience gained from the institute.

content.Placements: We were the first batch of students doing BPT at St John's and it's mandatory to do the internship there itself. No one is entertained to go out for internship and the placement opportunities are not available in John's for BPT, intake is only for MPT graduates currently.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was not adequate as the course was newly started but now there is a separate floor for physiotherapy in the college. There is our won physiotherapy branch in the hospital where there is outpatient and inpatient physiotherapy services are provided.

admission_process.title: St John’s Medical College Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: St John’s Medical admission process is different for all the courses. Admission to PG medical programmes(MD and MS)will be conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority(KEA)through Common Counselling. Registration for the course-specific entrance, exam-specific counselling, and final seat allotment are the common steps for shortlisted students. Find below the step-wise admission process:
1. Application

St John’s Medical College's application process differs with every course offered by the college. While, there are a few programmes for which the application must be submitted on the official website, programmes such as MBBS need no college-level application form. For,MBBS, BTech, MS, and MD candidatesseeking admission are required to apply via the Karnataka-CET 2026 entrance exam. For,BPT/MPT/ MSc/MHA/PhD admissioncandidates are required to apply via the official website of St John's Medical College and apply online.
2.Selection
Candidates must appear for exam-specific counselling & final seat allotment.
3. Final Admission
Post the final seat allotment, candidates who want admission can submit the fee and confirm their admission.

St John's Medical College fees range from INR 82,000 to INR 36.5 lakh. for PG programmes, the annual fee can be paid intwo Installments-every six months from the second year onwards. Also, John's provides thepostgraduate(medical courses) students astipendof INR 45,000 per month in their first year,INR 50,000in the second year andINR 55,000in the third year of the programme, as per current rules.

reviews.review_heading: The college was giving the best-quality placements to its students.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a very good infrastructure. Our college has labs for the practical knowledge of the students. reviews.review_heading: It has great placements, good infrastructure, a beautiful campus, a huge playground, etc.

Cleanliness is the first priority in the college, hospital, hostel, etc. We have a huge library, a study hall, and classrooms. There is a huge playground with separate facilities for cricket, football, volleyball, throwball, hockey, and tennis.

reviews.review_heading: I had a great experience at St. John's National Academy of Health Sciences.
reviews.review_text: We have an annual fest called Autumn Muse every year. We have arts and sports teams, and major sports include basketball, hockey, cricket, and volleyball. The library is huge and has almost all the books. It is air-conditioned. Hostels are clean and have all the required facilities. All the students are allotted rooms. Hostels are good and the food is very tasty. The best of these is the campus itself with full of greenery variety of plants, trees all maintained very well. There is a deer park which is an attraction to many tourists coming to Bangalore.

reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available overall the college building. We have a shortage of water only in the girls' hostel. Quality of food is bad, but we have a good sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am very happy to be a part of this prestigious institution.

We have single rooms with the required necessities. Food provided in the hospital PG mess is good. Our college also has good medical and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the facilities, good infrastructure, etc.

Reading rooms are open for 24 hours. Hostel Wi-Fi for ladies are not available. Mess food is not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best medical colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities provided are of international standards. Wi-Fi, library are of the best quality. Labs are highly specialised with all requirements. Sports and arts are highly encouraged in this college. Mess and hostel are also of good quality with all facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A place with peaceful and beautiful ambience for studies as well as co-curricular activities.
reviews.review_text: The college, hostel, and hospital Wi-Fi is available all the time. Labs are there for each department. Classrooms are available for each batch of students which is spacious and has monitors, screens, boards, CCTV cameras and other facilities. The library is open all day, and it is such a peaceful and calm place for studying and also for reference. Hostel facilities are adequate. They are provided with good food and drinking water. Medical facilities are available in the same hospital, which is n...

reviews.review_text: Terrible infrastructure for teaching and learning. The library has random books that are sufficient for reading and are outdated. The department doesn't even have chairs for students or faculty to sit in. Physiotherapy students are usually treated worse than cattle class as there is a culture of God complex among the doctors.

review_summary.college_name: AIIMS Raipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are very cooperative with us. Vacation is less, but this career is future-oriented.

content.Placements: After 3.5 years of the course, you have to do a compulsory paid internship. They give you 13,500 per month. After completion of your course, you will give NORCET for the nursing officer job. The salary is around 90,000 per month. Except this, you apply for government hospitals also.
content.Infrastructure: There are 4 labs, one library with Wi-Fi, 3 canteens, and 1 cafeteria in our college. There are 2 messes in our college. Mess food is available in both veg and non-veg. Mess food is compulsory, and you have to pay 4,000 per month for the mess. Hostel security is very good. A single room is provided. Water and current are free of cost.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Inside AIIMS Raipur life can be tough but it is worth it.

content.Placements: There are no placement criteria in nursing. You have to clear NORCET to get a job as a nursing officer in AIIMS. The salary is a very handsome amount, which is 80k per month. Internship is generally conducted during the last 6 months of the course with a stipend of 13.5k per month.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is highly up to date with Wi-Fi, labs for every department, and classrooms containing ACs and LED projectors. There is also a central library available that has plenty of books and journals, with an e-library facility also available. Hostels are free, but mess is chargeable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Life of a nursing student at AIIMS Raipur.

content.Placements: Every year 75 students are selected on the basis of a counseling procedure. Each student gets an internship in the hospital and is paid a stipend of 13,500/- for 6 months. We are posted in the hospital for better clinical exposure for better learning.
content.Infrastructure: We have a separate building known as the nursing college than the medical college. We have lab demonstrations for different departments such as NF, MSN OBG, CHN, etc. The food prepared by the mess is fine, but sometimes the quality is not so good. The menu is decided as per the students choices.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Not completely satisfied but overall it's good. Infrastructure is highly developed.

content.Placements: 75 students are there in each batch and every passed student in 3rd year gets a chance of internship during the 4th year which is the final year. Internship is for 6 months which provides good clinical exposure so students are more practically educated.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are highly advanced, library is also there which remains open for 24?7, Wi-Fi connection is there in the library, canteen is also there, games and sports are held during various time period and on various occasions, mess food is not that much good and the mess feels is also high.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the best medical colleges of India.

content.Placements: We have 75 students in our class with a B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing course. Our faculty is well educated; they provide us with more than enough knowledge regarding our course, which helps us in the future to clear the competition exams to get jobs easily. In our college, the top 3 courses are MBBS, nursing, and paramedical.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel has very nice infrastructure. We all have single rooms with attached washrooms in the 1st year, and after that, up to the 4th year, we have single rooms, but washrooms are not attached. The hostel provides us all the necessary things like a study table, chair, and night lamp. Also, we have windows for better ventilation. We have a separate mess where we get average food.
