reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very cooperative with us. Vacation is less, but this career is future-oriented.
reviews.review_text: There are 4 labs, one library with Wi-Fi, 3 canteens, and 1 cafeteria in our college. There are 2 messes in our college. Mess food is available in both veg and non-veg. Mess food is compulsory, and you have to pay 4,000 per month for the mess. Hostel security is very good. A single room is provided. Water and current are free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Inside AIIMS Raipur life can be tough but it is worth it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is highly up to date with Wi-Fi, labs for every department, and classrooms containing ACs and LED projectors. There is also a central library available that has plenty of books and journals, with an e-library facility also available. Hostels are free, but mess is chargeable.

reviews.review_heading: Life of a nursing student at AIIMS Raipur.
reviews.review_text: We have a separate building known as the nursing college than the medical college. We have lab demonstrations for different departments such as NF, MSN OBG, CHN, etc. The food prepared by the mess is fine, but sometimes the quality is not so good. The menu is decided as per the students choices.

reviews.review_heading: Not completely satisfied but overall it's good. Infrastructure is highly developed.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are highly advanced, library is also there which remains open for 24?7, Wi-Fi connection is there in the library, canteen is also there, games and sports are held during various time period and on various occasions, mess food is not that much good and the mess feels is also high.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best medical colleges of India.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel has very nice infrastructure. We all have single rooms with attached washrooms in the 1st year, and after that, up to the 4th year, we have single rooms, but washrooms are not attached. The hostel provides us all the necessary things like a study table, chair, and night lamp. Also, we have windows for better ventilation. We have a separate mess where we get average food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a good college, but life can be hectic, best for skill learning.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good with proper AC rooms, and everyone gets a single room hostel here, and no hostel fees, too. A central library is there where students can access different types of books, from story books to our study-related books. For sports, a playground is there. Gym facilities are there, too. Open gym and actual gym both are present. Mess food depends on the supplier, and a mess committee is there who regularly checks the quality of food and all.

reviews.review_heading: Review of AIIMS Raipur - All India Institute of Medical Sciences.
reviews.review_text: The college has 4 lecture theatres with central AC and can accommodate a strength of 150 to 200 people. The library is on 3rd floor with central AC and an e-Library with laptops and computers of Dell and HP. Labs are well-equipped with all the new facilities. We have a private mess which offers good quality food, like roti, curry, rice and also butter milk. We have chicken twice a week, on Wednesday and Sunday. Sports facilities like a basketball court and volleyball court are available. A crick...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with everything in our college.
reviews.review_text: Central Wi-Fi is available in our college for every staff and students. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped with new facilities and excellent infrastructures. Library is vast and two storied. E library is also available for every student and staff. Hostel is excellent as every student gets a single room with very tasty food. Canteen, mess are very hygienic. Sports and Games are organised every year by students union. Medical facilities are always available for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good infrastructure and placements in this course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was good. As there was a very campus and a very attractive college building. They also provide a 2-floor library with all course books. It provides free Wi-Fi in the library, with individual subjects laboratory and good practical demonstrations. The hostel security was good and the food served in the mess was good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides very good opportunities to gain good knowledge in our field.
reviews.review_text: We had proper facilities of college and hostel, good electricity supply, water facility and a hygienic place to live. There was a huge library with seating arrangements of more than 200 students at a time with air-conditioners.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a very underrated college in North India.
reviews.review_text: There is a well-suited single room for every student in the hostel, but Wi-Fi is not available in the hostel. However, Wi-Fi is available in the library, and the library is one of the best libraries in Raipur. AIIMS Raipur is spread over an area of 103 acres. The mess of AIIMS Raipur is very good, and the quality of the food served in it is very good. There are grounds for every sport like cricket, badminton, basketball and football.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study radiology at an affordable budget.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Hostel is not good but manageable. Wi-Fi was available in the library but not outside. Practical lab is good to do practicals every day. The quality of the food is good but it takes time to adjust to it for newcomers. Medical facilities are provided for students. Sports and games are held in December every year.

reviews.review_heading: AIIMS RAIPUR, Chhattisgarh.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of AIIMS is really good. It have a very big campus. It have many different hostel for each year student and have lifts in them (some). It has big playground for cricket, football, basketball and volleyball. If you wanna play indoor games even than you don't need to be disappointed, it has all the infrastructure you want.

individual_reviews.title: Life at Lady Hardinge Medical College as a medical student.

content.Placements: The total batch strength is 240. After the course gets completed, one has to compulsorily attend an internship of 1 year in the associated hospital which has its own stipend getting reviewed every year. After the completion, one becomes a certified MBBS doctor after which they choose to either practice or go through another entrance exam for PG exams to do their specialization.
content.Infrastructure: We have a newly built academic block where the lecture theatres are present with fully centralized air-conditioning. Library is open 24/7 with provisions of AC and Wi-Fi. Hostel is also available for the 1st to final year students and 1 room is allotted to 2 students. Everything is allowed except AC in the hostel rooms. The mess is also available which provides food 4 times a day, besides which other canteens are also available in the campus itself. Sports and games facilities are also there. Gym, swimming pool and various courts are also there.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I love my college and my college life. 100% placement is offered here.

content.Placements: I am currently a first-year, Batch 2022, MBBS student at Lady Hardinge Medical College. Also known as LHMC. It's a women's college for undergrads, and for postgrads, it is co-ed. There are 240 students in a batch. After MBBS, we go for PG. In an internship, all of us are paid INR 26,000 for a month, and in a PG, it depends on the college and the course chosen.
content.Infrastructure: We have provided buildings for our classes. We have assigned labs for each subject. We do have a library and a reading room that are available 24 hours a day. We have Wi-Fi only in the library. The hostel is good but needs more sanitation facilities. Mess is average, with breakfast, lunch, snacks at 4 p.m., and dinner. We have a swimming pool, a badminton court, and a gym. Obviously, we have outstanding medical facilities, as we have our own hospital.

admission_process.title: Lady Hardinge Medical College Admission Process

paragraphs: Lady Hardinge Medical College admission process 2024is mainlyentrance-based.Candidates need to appear forNEET examfor admission at LHMC.

Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC)is a government-funded medical college for women that offers several UG, PG and diploma programmes, such asMBBS, MD, MS, DMetc. These courses are offered through various LHMC departments includingPharmacology, Forensic Medicine,Community Medicineetc.The postgraduate courses are open to both male and female candidates.

For admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses the notification and prospectus is issued byUniversity of Delhi.Candidates are required to contact Dy. Registrar,Faculty of Medical Sciences, Patel Chest Building, University of Delhi directly.
Below is the eligibility and selection criteria for different courses of Lady Hardinge Medical College:
Eligibility
50% in Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English
MBBS Degree from a Medical College affiliated to University of Delhi and Date of completion of internship (12 months) on or before March, 31
Know more aboutLHMC courses
The details of seats available for the MBBS course under various categories are given below:
Total seats for MBBS
DU/state quota seats filled by DU on the basis of merit of AIPMT, conducted by CBSE :unreserved seats
Reserved seats for SC/ST/OBC (15%, 7.5% & 27% respectively)
23 SC, 12 ST, 42 OBC
Reserved seats for Physically Handicapped (PH) category
Candidates belonging to children/widows and wives of Armed and Para Military Personnel (CWWAPP) category
3% seats are reserved on horizontal basis( only for loco motory disabilities of lower limbs between 50 to 70 percent
5 percent seats are reserved on horizontal basis for this category
Government Nominees
All India Quota Seats (15%) filled through online counselling by MCC on the basis of merit of AIPMT, conducted by CBSE

faqs.question: When did NTA release the NEET 2024 result?
faqs.answer: NTA released the re-revised scorecard on July 26, 2024. In this scorecard, the score has been revised as per the Supreme Court verdict of removing the bonus marks awarded earlier for the controversial Physics question, and deducting one mark from those who marked incorrect answer options. The city and centre-wise result data such as number of candidates appeared and scores obtained, by masking candidates' personal data was released on July 21, as per the Supreme Court order given on the hearing dated July 18, 2024. The NEET 2024 result for the re-exam, which was conducted on June 23, was declared on July 1, day day after the slated date. The final answer keys for the NEET 2024 re-exam was released by June 30, ahead of the result declaration. Earlier, the result of NEET 2024 was declared by NTA on June 4, 2024, 10 days ahead of the original schedule, which was June 14, 2024. paragraphs: Lady Hardinge Medical College placement report 2023 is not released. However, according to Lady Hardinge Medical College NIRF report 2023, the median package offered during Lady Hardinge Medical College MBBS placements 2021 stood at INR 1 LPA . Further, the median package offered during Lady Hardinge Medical College PG 3-year placements 2022 stood at INR 1.2 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the highest salary package offered to MBBS students at Lady Hardinge Medical College?
faqs.answer: At Lady Hardinge Medical College, the maximum income package available to MBBS students is INR 45 LPA, while the lowest package is INR 9 LPA. Medical specialists and young doctors are among the top professions available. For experience ranging from three to four years, the average Lady Hardinge Medical College doctor salary in India is INR 11.5 Lakhs. The salary range for doctors at Lady Hardinge Medical College in India is INR 9.0 Lakhs to INR 14.0 Lakhs.

faqs.question: How is the placement facility at Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi?
faqs.answer: A specialised placement cell at Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC) works with hospitals, organizations, and other healthcare facilities to help place students in jobs. In addition, the career counseling service helps students prepare for interviews and explore a variety of career options. The strong alumni network of the university actively helps to secure placements and offers current students beneficial mentorship opportunities.

faqs.question: Does Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi have good placements?
faqs.answer: Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi has good placements. The college offers internships to all students in their final year under the central government. The stipend is good and higher than many other colleges in Delhi. The quality of placements is considered the best, and almost all students are placed in the internship course. The average salary for the internship is around 23,000 rupees. The average salary offered to students from Lady Hardinge Medical College is INR 9.7 Lacs per annum. However, the average salary for senior residents at the college ranges between INR 1.2 Lakhs to INR 20.0 Lakhs with an average annual salary of INR 11.5 Lakhs. The average monthly salary for laboratory technicians at the college is around INR 19,481, while the average monthly salary for senior residents is around INR 115,000

faqs.question: What is the placement percentage for Lady Hardinge Medical College for the MBBS course?
faqs.answer: Lady Hardinge Medical College has a placement percentage of around 60% for the MBBS course. The monthly salary of MBBS doctors at Lady Hardinge Medical College can range from INR 24,702 to INR 26,355, and the average Lady Hardinge Medical College doctor salary is INR 11.3 lakhs per year. The average annual salary at Lady Hardinge Medical College is INR 10.1 lakh. If students start working after the MBBS course, they get a salary of INR 50,000 to INR 60,000 per month.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Lady Hardinge Medical College as a medical student.
reviews.review_text: We have a newly built academic block where the lecture theatres are present with fully centralized air-conditioning. Library is open 24/7 with provisions of AC and Wi-Fi. Hostel is also available for the 1st to final year students and 1 room is allotted to 2 students. Everything is allowed except AC in the hostel rooms. The mess is also available which provides food 4 times a day, besides which other canteens are also available in the campus itself. Sports and games facilities are also there. Gy...

reviews.review_heading: I love my college and my college life. 100% placement is offered here.
reviews.review_text: We have provided buildings for our classes. We have assigned labs for each subject. We do have a library and a reading room that are available 24 hours a day. We have Wi-Fi only in the library. The hostel is good but needs more sanitation facilities. Mess is average, with breakfast, lunch, snacks at 4 p.m., and dinner. We have a swimming pool, a badminton court, and a gym. Obviously, we have outstanding medical facilities, as we have our own hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Hostel is great. There is a decent library in this college. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Hardinge-the legacy and pride.
reviews.review_text: The negative point is hostel doesn't have Wi-Fi and library is the only source for it. The food is okay, though better than at other institutes. The classrooms in the new building are really good; they are well equipped with AC, projectors, CCTV, and great benches.

reviews.review_heading: The Epitome of Medical Education - Lad Hardinge Medical college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is absolutely magnificient. The hospital and academic building have been newly constructed and offers various first class amenities like 24hrs AC service, explicitly cleaned lecture theatre, corridors, wards, hygienic washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Our college is a bit old, and the older building lacks good infrastructure. The new building is well equipped with almost everything we need. The hostel is also quite old. It lacks some facilities, like air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Lecture theatres are fully centralised air-conditioned with comfortable seats. Projectors and whiteboards are available. All the essential laboratory equipment is available for teaching purposes. Wi-Fi is available. The library is available 24X7. Triple-seater hostel rooms are provided to 1st-year students. Double-seater hostel rooms are provided to 2nd and 4th-year students. Single rooms are provided for the internship students. Mess served food 4 times a day i.e., breakfast, lunch, snacks, and...

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Our hospital OPDs shifted to a new building. Classrooms are according to modern technology. Library and campus are provided with Wi-Fi facilities. The quality of mess food is not good but the hostel rooms are properly ventilated. Games and medical facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is worth the fee paid with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and a library are available in our college. It has 2 buildings. The old building consists of departments like physiology, anatomy, SGT, and anatomy dissection. The new academic block has air-conditioners for summer, heaters for winter, and washrooms with mirrors. It has smart classrooms and a great environment to study. The hostel is average with simple rooms and a good mess. Mess serves breakfast, milk, and a variety of food items. The canteen serves good food and a PG mess is available t...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best place of diversity.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are good. Wi-Fi facility is available in our college. A biometric attendance system has just been installed in our college which is great. The hostel rooms are good and spacious.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best and most affordable colleges.
reviews.review_text: Our library is one of the oldest medical libraries in the country, with a 24-hour reading room facility. Recently, the college has got its new academic building with top facilities and a newly built canteen. The college has many societies for both academic and non-academic activities, and the student union takes care of the interests of the undergraduates. The old hostel buildings are not very good as the college has been standing for over 106 years, but the new buildings are well built. Fans, b...

reviews.review_heading: Lady Hardinge Medical College is a premier teaching hospital with a proud legacy.
reviews.review_text: Recently, a whole new academic state-of-the-art academic block came into operation, elevating the college infrastructure greatly. The lecture theatres are huge with central air-conditioning and are equipped with the latest gizmos like screens and projectors. The washrooms in both the hostel and the college are pretty bad and can be improved.

reviews.review_heading: I am completely satisfied with Lady Hardinge Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good as it is newly built. Earlier, we had the old (laal) building where lectures were conducted. Now, there is completely new infrastructure, well-equipped with air conditioners and clean and proper washrooms. The library is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and is fully equipped with air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing experience if you remove the hostel facility.
reviews.review_text: Getting a hostel for a DU quota student is next to impossible, the hostel authorities aren't very supportive. Unless you are an intern, you won't be getting any room, that easily. AC is not allowed in the hostel so it gets tough to survive in Delhi summers. The food available in the mess is satisfactory. The people you'll find here make everything bearable and fun so that's a plus.

But then again it's overall fine

Step 2: Selection: The selectionprocess may vary from course to course at MMDU Ambala. Candidates must meet the required entrance examination score. fees_and_eligibility.overview:
GMCH Chandigarh offers various UG and PG courses across various specialisations. At the UG level, the college offers MBBS (inclusive of a one-year rotational internship) and BHMS courses, BOPTM, BDS, and BSc courses. At the PG level, the college offers three-year MD and MS courses. The college also offers a three-year DPN, DM and 1-2 year MPhil courses to the students. The MD is offered in 11 specialisations and the MS in five specialisations.

The modes of GMCH Chandigarh admission are online and offline. The admission to various courses is done on the basis of merit in competitive exams and is based on the combined entrance test. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by GMCH Chandigarh and their respective eligibility and fee:

faqs.answer: A:    GCET is the entrance test conducted by GMCH Chandigarh to shortlist applicants for BSc admission. The exam consists of 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs). The syllabus for the exam may vary across the specialisations. The medium of GCET is English only. Each question carries one mark and there is no negative marking for wrong answers. The duration of the entrance test is two hours. Interested candidates can apply for the exam through the college's official website as and when the application window opens.
faqs.question: What is the exam pattern of the GCET conducted by GMCH Chandigarh for BSc admission?

individual_reviews.course: MD in General Medicine - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of GMCH Chandigarh - Government Medical College and Hospital.

content.Placements: Government Medical College and Hospital, Chandigarh (GMCH), offers strong placement opportunities, particularly in the medical field. There are no traditional placements with companies recruiting, and graduates are well-prepared for various career paths, including government jobs, postgraduate studies, and private practice. All GMCHs provide compulsory internships, often with a stipend. Many graduates secure positions in medical offices or pursue further specialisation.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is not that big. It is very beautiful at the same time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Short review of GMCH college for nursing.

content.Placements: I am from batch 2023 B.Sc. Nursing (currently in second year, 3rd sem nursing). Almost everyone, but placement doesn’t depend upon the college as there is no direct placement. Placement depends upon how good you studied in your course. The highest – many of the students cleared NCLEX from our college. The lowest – can’t say anything. Generally, students prefer to work in AIIMS. Yes, everyone gets a chance for an internship.
content.Infrastructure: For nursing, it is very poor. Like, only 2 lecture theatres in college and clinical hours are too much. The hostel is combined with the two lecture theatres, which is awful. For attending external subjects, we have to go to E block many times, which is really frustrating. College timing is 9 to 5. No Wi-Fi for students. The library is too good (2 libraries in college). No canteen in college, but in E block of the hospital, there are lots of canteens.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I can't say this college is good or bad, but placement is good, and the future is secure.

content.Placements: All students were placed as it is a medical college and MBBS as a degree allows everyone to earn money. Everyone was allowed for internships. Some crack their NEET PG, and some of them go towards USMLE and PLAB for pursuing their medicine from abroad.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good for students. Hostels are very good with all facilities. Only hostel food is not good; rest everything is very good. Seniors are friendly too. Wi-Fi is not available in hostels, but the library is present in three blocks of the college with Wi-Fi and good infrastructure. Classrooms are also fully equipped with Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My MBBS journey at GMC, Chandigarh.

content.Placements: GMCH is the best medical college in India. At GMCH, all the students get internships for our course. For placements, students have to pass the PG Exam, and on this basis, they get placed in various hospitals. The average package offered for our course was 5–8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: GMCH has really good infrastructure for our course. In our course, all the necessary facilities, like labs and hospitals, were available for the students to practice. Students also got other facilities like sports, canteen, hostel, library, Wi-Fi, etc., at this college.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides great internships.

content.Placements: No placements are provided here because it's a medical college, but you can join a hospital of your choice. You can also prepare for NEET PG for 1 year and then do a speciality course like MD or MS. An internship of one year is compulsory, for which you get a stipend of Rs. 31,000 per month, which is above average.
content.Infrastructure: All the required books are not easily available. Sometimes, we have to order them from Amazon. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The hostels have two-seater and single-seater rooms. Each room has enough space. Rooms are very clean and have adequate lights and fans. The food served in the mess is of high quality. They serve chicken, fish, and paneer every week. PGs and rental rooms are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GMCH Chandigarh - Government Medical College and Hospital.
reviews.review_text: The campus is not that big. It is very beautiful at the same time.

reviews.review_heading: Short review of GMCH college for nursing.
reviews.review_text: For nursing, it is very poor. Like, only 2 lecture theatres in college and clinical hours are too much. The hostel is combined with the two lecture theatres, which is awful. For attending external subjects, we have to go to E block many times, which is really frustrating. College timing is 9 to 5. No Wi-Fi for students. The library is too good (2 libraries in college). No canteen in college, but in E block of the hospital, there are lots of canteens.

reviews.review_heading: I can't say this college is good or bad, but placement is good, and the future is secure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good for students. Hostels are very good with all facilities. Only hostel food is not good; rest everything is very good. Seniors are friendly too. Wi-Fi is not available in hostels, but the library is present in three blocks of the college with Wi-Fi and good infrastructure. Classrooms are also fully equipped with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: My MBBS journey at GMC, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: GMCH has really good infrastructure for our course. In our course, all the necessary facilities, like labs and hospitals, were available for the students to practice. Students also got other facilities like sports, canteen, hostel, library, Wi-Fi, etc., at this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides great internships.
reviews.review_text: All the required books are not easily available. Sometimes, we have to order them from Amazon. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The hostels have two-seater and single-seater rooms. Each room has enough space. Rooms are very clean and have adequate lights and fans. The food served in the mess is of high quality. They serve chicken, fish, and paneer every week. PGs and rental rooms are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best in all aspects especially highly qualified faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are amazing in all aspects of needs. The Wi-Fi is available 24*7, labs are well-maintained, classrooms are neat and well-modified with screens. The facilities available in the hostel are good. The food served in the hostel is always healthy and great every day, and we enjoy it. Canteens are well diverse, medical facilities are very strong. There are sports and games activities available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: College life at GMCH, Chandigarh, is great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is great, and they provide everything you need in this course. All the labs are well-equipped and functional. But the hostels are not that great, as the hostel building is very old and rusty. The hostel lifts are dark and have no provision for lighting.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GMCH Chandigarh - Government Medical College and Hospital.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good in the course and department. Every facility is given to the students as well as doctors to teach and take care of patients, staff, and the public. The hostel facility is good. Huge rooms are given to the students depending on the degree and students. Every game like basketball, cricket, volleyball, football and table tennis is available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GMCH Chandigarh - Government Medical College and Hospital.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good in the course and department. Every facility is given to students as well as doctors to teach and take care of patients, staff members, and the public. Hostel facilities are good, and big rooms are given to the students depending on the degree and students. Basketball, cricket, volleyball, football, table tennis, and all games are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. It also has good location. The library is the most peaceful and also the best place on the entire campus to study. You can get every reference book required here. Hostels are also good. You have to share rooms in the beginning years, but as you pass, it upgrades to finally having a single-seater. Seniors are also very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has the best value for money with the best infrastructure and city. Everything is best.
reviews.review_text: The new building of our college is very well-equipped with all the required systems. Labs are very good, and they are well maintained with the latest equipment. Our college is very beautiful, and Chandigarh city is also very nice. Sports facilities are not very good, and there is no gym. The hostel is also not very clean, and the food served in the hostel is average.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good and reputed medical college.
reviews.review_text: Chandigarh is the best city in India. The college is good, and the campus is not huge. The hospital is just like any other government hospitals. The library is opened for 24 hours. Students are frank, good and studious. A great badminton court is available. The college organises a fest named Euphoria, every year.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The quality of labs and classrooms is amazing. All are centrally air-conditioned. Benches in the classrooms are comfortable. The equipment is up to date as well. The quality of the food in the canteen is hygienic and tasty. I haven't faced any issues related to the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, but infrastructure can be made more beautiful and appealing.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi, only rooms to live, classrooms are now fine, but still, everything can be done more perfectly. Gym is there, but it's not proper. More infrastructure and hostels can be built well, we are thankful to our college for all, but government needs to recognize us. Hospital is very good. Infrastructure can be improved, and rest is getting good. of hostels there is regular cleaning and washing there are 5 canteens food is good, food is fresh, and there is regulated shifting of diets, everythin...

content.Placements: In MBBS, 89% of students get placed, and in MD, 86% of students get placed. The salary package offered is 8.40 LPA for MBBS and 15.8 LPA for PG. Abbott, GSK, and ERIS Life Sciences are the top recruiters. 100% of MBBS students do one year of compulsory internships at a KMC-affiliated hospital. Stipend is about Rs. 30,000 per month. Clinical practice roles are offered in hospitals for public health roles.

The campus is comfortable and well furnished with amenities, hygiene, and maintenance.

paragraphs: KMC Mangalore admissions are currently open for various courses. The college offers various programmes at theUG, PG and certificate levelsin the field ofMedical Science.Kasturba Medical College Mangaloreoffers entrance and merit-based admission. The application form is available on the official website of theManipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). Candidates are required to register for their desired programme by paying an application fee ofINR 600on an online portal MAHE. Read below to learn more about KMC Mangalore admission 2025,along with course-wise eligibility and selection criteria and admission process:
Manipal 2025 Applications Open|Apply Now

KMC Mangalore admissions 2025 areopenfor some courses like MS, MD, etc. The college accepts scores of college-level and national-level entrance exams, such as NEET. For a few courses, however, admission is subject to scores obtained by the candidates in the MET entrance. KMC Mangalore admission process is conducted in online mode. The college offers BSc, MSc, MS and other programmes at the UG and PG levels. It also offers a certificate programme. An overview of KMC Mangalore courses eligibility & selection criteria for admission 2025 is as follows:
Eligibility
Selection Criteria
Pass Class 10 and Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry and English with Biology / Mathematicsfrom a recognised Board, with a minimum of 45 %aggregate marks in PCB / PCM

Check here for detailed eligibility criteria for moreKMC Mangalore courses

Kasturba Medical College Mangalore admission process 2025 is bothentrance and merit-based. Candidates seeking admission to KMC Mangalore must qualify for the respective entrance exams and other selection rounds including applying online on the official website of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). Checkout the following steps for a detailedKMC Mangalore admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Candidates looking for admission to various courses at KMC Mangalore are required to submit an online application form along with a registration fee ofINR 600. The application form will not be accepted by the college without submitting the required documents.
Step 2: Selection Round

As part of the selection process, candidates are required to qualify for the college/ national-level entrance exam basis the course-level eligibility set by the college. The selection criteria vary from one course to another, for instance, for MBBS and MD courses applicants are required to appear for NEET-PG to get admission, however, for BSc, MSc, MPT and others, the college conducts its own entrance exam conducted by MAHE. After the selection rounds are over, the college releases a list of shortlisted candidates based on their eligibility fulfilment and scores in the selection rounds.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment
KMC Mangalore releases a merit list after the selection rounds are over based on their eligibility fulfilment and scores in the selection rounds.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected candidates in theKMC Mangalore cutofflist must required to payKMC Mangalore course feepayment within the given dates to lock their seats.

faqs.question: Is KMC Mangalore BSc admission merit-based or entrance-based?
faqs.answer: KMC Mangalore BSc admissionis entirely entrance-based for the academic year 2024 as the institute accepts the rank and scores obtained by candidates in the Manipal Entrance Test (MET) following which a merit list is prepared and selected candidates are invited to appear for the counselling. In the merit list,  50% weightage is given to the MET score and 50% to the marks obtained in Class 12 examinations.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in BSc at Kasturba Medical College Mangalore?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the BSc programme offered at Kasturba Medical College Mangalorecannot get direct admissionas the institute accepts the rank and scores achieved by candidates in the Manipal Entrance Test (MET) following which a merit list is prepared. In the merit list,  50% weightage is given to the MET score and 50% weightage to the marks obtained in Class 12 examinations.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to various courses at Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore?
faqs.answer: Applicants cannot get direct admission in any of the undergraduate, postgraduate, super specialty or fellowship programme offered by the college. The college accepts the scores and rank of multiple entrance examinations. Candidates must appear for NEET UG for admission in MBBS programme, NEET PG for MD programmes. Manipal Entrance Test/ department tests are also conducted for admission in the BSc, MSc,   MPT, and others.

faqs.question: Can I join Kasturba Medical College directly?
faqs.answer: To join Kasturba Medical College, candidates must appear and qualify in the NEET-PG. After qualifying in the exam, candidates can apply for direct admission in MBBS at Kasturba Medical College through management quota and NRI seats. The college is affiliated with the Manipal Academy of Higher Education and approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

reviews.review_heading: Top-notch medical education with excellent clinical exposure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided. There is a large capacity library with rich digital and print collections. We also have modern medical labs, and a simulation center for hands-on experience and training. There are four hospitals with specialty services and teaching exposure. The campus is comfortable and well furnished with amenities, hygiene, and maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: Life at KMC Mangalore as an undergraduate doctor.
reviews.review_text: In my college, you will get a proper campus for only the first year; after that, you will be shifted to another hostel, and from there, all the venues for classes and postings are at different places, so you will mostly need a vehicle. The hostel mess is good, and all other facilities are great. There is a sports complex in the college where you can play squash, football, basketball, table tennis, etc., and there is a gym, but you have to pay for it.

reviews.review_heading: BPT programme in KMC Bangalore provides good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities, including air-conditioned classrooms and labs. The central library at Falnir has a wide selection of books and research publications. The hostel fee is around INR 1,20,000, which includes a mess card that can be used like an ATM card in the mess. The college has a sports complex called the Manipal Arena, which is free to use except for the gym.

reviews.review_heading: Detailed review of KMC, Mangalore.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available except air conditioners. The food quality is okay, neither too good nor too bad. Sports and extra curricular activities are conducted in the Arena. There are many sports played in the Arena like basketball, badminton, etc. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college that provides an excellent balance of academics and social activities.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the college is really good. It offers a calm environment for students to carry on with their work. The hostel facility provided by the college is quite promising. The rooms are well furnished with all the basic amenities needed by students. The mess is kept clean and the food is decent in there. Medical facilities are available for students 24/7; ambulance services are provided when needed; and there are basketball and badminton courts on the campus itself.

reviews.review_heading: There are ample opportunities here.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are newly made with all the kinds of amenities related to audio-visual aids are available. There is a Wi-Fi facility available which is a bit slow. The hostels are in good conditions along with the wardens being  good. Regular cleaning is done in the hostels to ensure hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS/BDS at KMC helping learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: Best of the facilities are provided here, experienced clinicians and faculty who are always available to guide and support in academics and beyond. Hostel offers conducive environment for students to grow. Mess food is hygienic and nutritious. Moreover, suitable for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, Happy and Recommendable for those who can afford.
reviews.review_text: The college has a really good campus and hostel Life is the best for freshers and after that the freshers have to shift to nandagiri hostel (girls) and kaprigudda (boys). So the environment is really student friendly and also very clean. Library is very nice. Mess food is very nice. People come for inspection every month. Wi-Fi is available in the library as well as the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: For hostels, students have two options i.e air-conditioner double seater and non-air-conditioner double seater. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and on campus. Laboratories, classrooms, and library are well furnished. In the KMC Bangalore to overcome the ragging, there is a separate campus for 1st-year students. Mess food is better than in other hostels. Life of Medical students

The campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. Classroom are centralised AC with all facilities. Hostel are in Bejai (1st year only) and Kaprigudda and Sturrock (NRI). There is sport complex Marena with all sport facilities gym etc.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a good option for quality medical education, and it provides good campus life.
reviews.review_text: Classroom, laboratories, and libraries are fully air-conditioned. While in hostel rooms students have an option for an air-conditioner or non-air-conditioner on the whole campus. The hostels are fully Wi-Fi access, and classrooms have projectors, speakers for better audio-visual lectures. Mess food is rich in variety, students get all the north Indian food, and even snacks like tikki, samosa, maggi, vada pav, etc., which are good.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best medical colleges in India and is part of Manipal Academy of higher education.

Hostel facilities and mess facilities are all good. We are provided with a good library in the hostel as well, which is open 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: A good college, worth the money spent, best decision of my life.

A sports campus called marina is also there wh oh has a gym available with trainers as well. Canteen is also good. And the hostels are comfortable with mess food better than most hostel messes as heard. Being a medical college medical facilities are A1.

Here are the details: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Nursing: First-year fees: INR 78,750 Duration: 3 years Specialization: Nursing | Medical Laboratory Technology Compared to other medical courses, the B.Sc programme at DMCH offers a reasonable fees. The overall expenses that might occur including the hostel fees and other accommodation fees, the cost of studying B.Sc at the Dayanand Medical College still seems to be very effective than any other college in this field. As per reviews of Alumi - the campus is good, placements as well and the faculty is very experienced and interactive. With the all these benefits the cost of the fees with the quality of service provided does not seem expensive.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel was in the college premises, but that building has now been transformed into the administrative block. At present, there are no hostel facilities. But, there was a college canteen inside the college premises.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good overall.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure that have been provided to us by our college are such that we have all the basic amenities in our college provided by our college. Other than that, we also have labs, library and other required necessities for a smooth college life and learning.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worth it for any and every specialization or course.
reviews.review_text: Yes, high-speed internet is available through the Wi-Fi. The library has a vast collection of books for the students of all departments to read. The hostels have a premium feel, and all the important amenities are available. The food provided in the mess is of excellent quality as well.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college organises various seminars and workshops to enhance the learning skills of students. Other than that, there are cultural as well as sports related programs in the college. Ectopia is the cultural fest and Nozit is the sports fest which is conducted every year. College does have hostel facility for the students. Hostel rooms are neat and clean. There are only 3 students in each room. All rooms and washrooms are kept clean. Food quality of the mess is very good and all hygienic measure...

reviews.review_heading: I had a good experience with our college and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are easily available both in the college and hospital campus. This college mainly considers the health of every student. The entire campus is air-conditioned. The food served in the hostel is also very good. So, I suggest you to work hard and pass in the exams.

reviews.review_heading: Very much satisfied; a very good college to study and to stay. The best faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college's infrastructure is very nice, and classrooms and libraries are wonderful. Sports are good in our college, and they conduct sports meet monthly. Tournaments with other colleges are conducted once in three months. Hostel rooms are also very good, but the maintenance is not that good. Overall, it is okay. I did not face any issues regarding infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The college has an outstanding infrastructure and great faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has an outstanding infrastructure. Fully enabled Wi-Fi in the college and the hostel. The classrooms are modern, comfortable, large and air-conditioned. The college has an outstanding library. The latest facilities are available in this college. Only negative point is the college and girls hostel is 1.5 km away from hospital and boys hostel. The college has a smaller ground. The labs are equipped with the latest equipment. There are a lot of models and specimens.

reviews.review_heading: I think the best college in whole Punjab. I love this college
reviews.review_text: Talking about the infrastructure the college is the best class and also have Wi-Fi. Labs are also highly professional and the college is providing best class lectures talking about the sports it is conducting every year. The staff in this college is trustful and is helpful at every situations.

reviews.review_heading: My review about Dayanand Medical College and Hospital.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities of my college were quite good. Every week, the hostel food was checked by nutritionists. Apart from this, only three students lived in a room, but if someone wanted to live alone, they were also given permission for that. The college also provided bus facilities for hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Real colors of DMC&H, college of nursing, Ludhiana, Malakpur.
reviews.review_text: College has a gym, mess, and TV room, but none of the gym equipment works, and the TV subscription is not even renewed. There is a large ground and a basketball court. The rooms are small considering the number of people living in them. The food is average, with no fruits or milk served. The canteen is too expensive, and online food delivery is not allowed. Outings are also prohibited, and parents are not allowed to enter the campus unless the warden gives permission. While it is understandable ...

hostel.description: Students have exclusive hostels for Boys and Girls with spacious, comfortable, well-furnished rooms with all modern amenities, hygienic kitchens, nutritious food, and portable RO water source is provided for drinking. Each hostel block has a separate pantry and laundry facility. Students wishing to stay in these hostels are advised to apply in the prescribed forms. Solar emergency source is utilized for heating and cooking purpose in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will always recommend this college to upcoming students.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and all provide good quality food in our canteen. It has pure vegetarian food only. We have a Wi-Fi facility, a well-equipped laboratory, and classrooms. The library has every minor detail book related to studies. Overall, it's the best.

reviews.review_heading: JSS Medical College. An excellent choice.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is decent and labs are well-equipped with the latest technology for better student understanding. The hostel infrastructure is outstanding with multiple types of rooms available for students including both common and attached washroom options. There are Wi-Fi-enabled labs and a library on the college campus. The food facility in the hostel is decent. The medical facilities are available, and there is also a canteen on campus. Many sports facilities are provided for stu...

reviews.review_heading: College is good. Friends are great. Campus and everything is good.
reviews.review_text: Our course is good. Teaching is good and there is a library to read. Wi-Fi is also available but there is no hostel facility. Hostel is there but only for MBBS students for them hostel is too good. Food is best compared to other hostel food. It is hygienic and hostel rooms are very clean for B.Sc. Outside PGs are available they are also too good like college hostel.

reviews.review_heading: This college is top 24 in India this would be the best college you choose.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus, highly facilitated laboratory, many ongoing research, availability of very good books. Wi-Fi and smart class facilitated classrooms, digital library, and library till midnight even have a department library also free research journals.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for research, good infrastructure, and well-equipped labs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is superb. The building is nice and well-planned with good architecture. The campus is also nice and eco-friendly. Classrooms are very spacious, and there is a very big auditorium. The college has two libraries: one is the main library, and the other is the digital library. The Wi-Fi connection is good, and anyone can use it.

reviews.review_heading: Very happy and satisfied with faculties and really good infrastructure. I loved it.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is the best; the faculties are direct to us; they help us in every manner; they explain in details; and most important, the PowerPoint they make and study is so clear and makes us concentrated; everyone is given the opportunity to keep their thoughts based on the topics.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSS Medical College, JSS Academy of Higher Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are various classrooms and different buildings for separate courses like life sciences , MBBS, BS, etc. There are 2 libraries, one of which is a digital library, both with high-quality wifi . Hostel mess is good, though only vegetarian food is served.

reviews.review_heading: Actually, the infrastructure has to be improved.
reviews.review_text: No big infrastructure. I stay in PG that’s outside of the campus. Infrastructure has to be improved. We don’t get classrooms as such for us only. We’ll have to shift from one class to another with other years. Hope this will be completely confidential.

reviews.review_heading: Good curriculum and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is free all over the college. Classrooms are super clean with fans and some have AC. The library is excellent with ample space. The hostel is good with around 1 lakh per year, providing vegetarian food. The canteen is spacious with good hygiene. Medical facilities include a health card for each student, with free consultation and medicine from JSS hospital. Sports are conducted yearly, and an outdoor gym is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Found everything good at this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of JSS Medical College are very well maintained and developed. The college management provides high-quality educational facilities to its students. The campus has Wi-Fi, medical labs, a library, a canteen, and sports facilities. Hostel facilities are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: JSS review with an amazing campus.
reviews.review_text:
We have Wi-Fi facilities for the whole campus, including the hostel and college. The library has a vast variety of books and is equipped with computers and Wi-Fi. For lectures, we have a smart board.

Candidates willing to get admission at UCMS must complete the entire admission procedure, which includes multiple steps. The admission process is as follows:
Step 1: UCMS Application Process

UCMS application process differs with every course offered by the college. While, there are a few programmes for which the application must be submitted on the official website, programmes such as MBBS need no college-level application form.
Step 2: UCMS Entrance Exam/ NEET Exam

University College of Medical Sciences entrance examis conducted by Delhi University for admission to the BSc and MSc courses. Candidates must apply for the course while registering at the UCMS's official website. Appear for the entrance exam and score valid marks. As for the MBBS and other PG programmes, candidates must appear for the NEET exam and get a valid score as per the NEET cutoff marks.
Step 3: UCMS Counselling/ NEET Counselling

MSc and BSc candidates after clearing the DU entrance exam are required to attend the counselling conducted by the college. reviews.review_heading: The college and the campus both are great.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the college facilities, the college has 4 lecture theatres and all the LTs have A.C. and projectors. Overall condition is very good. Apart from that, labs have all the equipment for practical purposes for MBBS students. One library cum reading room is there too, the condition is awesome, e-library facility is there too. All kinds of books are available, whether by Indian authors or foreign authors. The reading room facility is available 24/7. Good food at a very reasonable price is...

reviews.review_heading: The heart of east Delhi - UCMS.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. There is a presence of lecture halls for classes to be held, and it is fully air-conditioned with Wi-Fi. The library is open from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM with all medical books available. There is a presence of labs and skill labs. The hostel is present for both girls and boys. Hostel is allotted to the students living at least 30 KM away from college. The mess is associated hostel.

reviews.review_heading: University College of Medical Sciences. UC! UC!
reviews.review_text: UCMS has a huge campus, which includes the Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTB). GTB hospital acts as a training hospital and has 1000 beds. It provides facilities like a central workshop, animal house, hospital laboratory services unit, hostel, medical illustration and photography, medical education unit, skill lab, and canteen. The college also has technological facilities which include audio-video, telemedicine, and electronics.

reviews.review_heading: Some of the best memories I have in UCMS.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the lecture halls, they are pretty big and have adequate lighting and comfortable seats. They are fully AC, but the AC does break down in extreme summers. We have a projector for presentation and a smart board now. Labs: We have all the labs having okayish equipment. Like it's not too advanced or new. But we do have a new skills lab that has very advanced equipment. Food: We have a doctor's canteen that serves an amazing variety of food for low prices. We also have emergency cantee...

reviews.review_heading: Ucms- a short review This review tells about the course details of the college.
reviews.review_text: There is projector for presentations and a touch whiteboards. The library and reading room services are amazing. There is no public Wi-Fi. For food we have canteen which has good food with reasonable price.

reviews.review_heading: University College of Medical Sciences: Pioneer in Medical Research.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is well maintained. There are 4 lecture halls, all fully air-conditioned, with a seating capacity of about 200 students. Labs and demonstration rooms are well-equipped with required materials. The library is well furnished with sufficient books from various top-notch publishers and in varied fields of medicine. Wi-Fi is available in the whole college building and library. There is also a reading room with a capacity of 200 students at a time. The hostel is separate for...

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good. Good college; every member is disciplined and qualified.
reviews.review_text: Our annual fest is Sargam, but it's not the only event, as the college is full of events. Every month, we have some events, and there are many departments, and departmental fests are also of large magnitude. Classrooms are equipped with all the latest amenities, and mind you, it's the sporting facilities on the campus that made our college one of the best.

reviews.review_heading: UCMS is one of the best medical colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available in the lecture theatre, library, labs, wards, and hospital. A projector is used for teaching purposes, and a skill lab is available for learning new skills related to medical sciences. Simulation of various disciplines is provided for better learning.

reviews.review_heading: Huge campus with a great alumni network.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in this college is quite old now and needs to be built from scratch. Though the existing infrastructure is pretty well maintained. The library is one of the best in India for a medical college and has its own app. There is a basketball court along with a field. The mess and hostel rooms are average. Single rooms are provided from 1st year onwards. The canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University College of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good; the whole college is air-conditioned and equipped with fast Wi-Fi. Classrooms are excellent compared to other medical colleges. The library is also equipped with almost all medical books and has various journals and medical papers, also Wi-Fi equipped. Hostel food is very good if you ask the freshers, but slowly your taste buds will get used to it, and you will crave something better. But overall, you have options for eating either from the mess or from the canteen. ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of University College of Medical Science.
reviews.review_text: The college is old but has all the necessary facilities, like research labs, rooms, and undergraduate and postgraduate labs. The campus is fully air-conditioned with Wi-Fi facilities. The Central Library is also present with all the necessary books. All the necessary facilities are provided to the students, like a doctor's canteen, a reading room, and a parking area for vehicles.

reviews.review_heading: College life is just awesome here.
reviews.review_text: Full campus is fully air conditioned with Wi-Fi facility. Central library is also present with all the necessary books. Hostels are present separately for boys and girls which are fully furnished. Both indoor and outdoor games facility is present within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Every year, I am pleased with faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are good. The library or reading room is open 24X7. The hostel facilities are good. The mess food is tasty and they serve us a variety of foods. In hostels, sports are very good. Various sporting events and tournaments are held.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University College of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not that good since it was constructed in 1971, but it is still good to go. Students are assigned a single room beginning in their first year. The campus is lush green with a playground for students to play on. The food quality is good. The library contains many journals and over 20,000 books.

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing college with good infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text: There are centrally air conditioned lecture theatres with a quite decent capacity. Labs are also well maintained. There is library and reading room encouraging the students to study in a calm competitive environment. The doctor's canteen offers a variety of food items at very reasonable rates.

review_content.Placements: 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. We need improvement in all these areas.

overview_faqs.question: How is hostel fee charged for the candidates who join in the middle of the session at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: At Jamia Hamdard, the hostel fee is charged for the whole academic year. If a student is allotted the hostel in the middle of the session, the hostel charges are then calculated quarterly as mentioned below:First quarter: July 1 to September 30Second quarter: October 1 to December 31Third quarter: January 1 to March 31Fourth Quarter: April 1 to June 30

overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: In case a student does not join the hostel but informs the Provost Office within a week after payment of the hostel fee about the withdrawal, the hostel charges are then refunded after deduction of INR 1000. In case the student withdraws admission within one month of joining of hostel, the fee is refunded after a deduction of 25% of the hostel fee. In any other case, no fee except security deposit is refundable. It is refunded to the hosteller after he/she has paid all dues and vacated the hostel.

Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need ...

reviews.review_heading: Not the best but not the worst either.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available, but it rarely works, and data services are negligible here. A lot of issues arise because of that. Classrooms are normal college classrooms with no AC and old fans. The library is functional with a huge number of books but most are outdated. The hostel facilities are great with good rooms, AC, and water supply. The curfew time is 9:30 PM, and the food is a bit hygienic, but not that bad. The sports facilities are great with a huge ground available, and other sports eq...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are available for students, and a maximum of 60 students can be in a classroom. The library is also available to assist students. Safe and separate hostels with good hygienic food quality are available for boys and girls. Majeedia Hospital provides medical facilities, and sports grounds are available for games.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a CSE day scholar student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classrooms are without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review by student living life on campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classes also have projectors but without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the evergreen Jamia Hamdard University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is well-maintained. It has Wi-Fi, computer labs for doing editing on photoshops, Premiere Pro, Adobe software, and studios for news and radio. It provides a lot of hands-on workshops. The interior of the college where students sit is well-organised and has 99 names of Allah, where everyone feels peace alone at their free time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive faculty, a room with solid placement, and is industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Jamia Hamdard offers well-equipped laps, Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, a rich library diverse sports facilities, and so on. The campus has a hygienic mess and canteen, reliable medical services, and a sports complex for indoor and outdoor games ensuring holistic student development.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is so clean and green. It was not good in past 2010 but now it is so good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is provided on our campus like Wi-Fi and AC. Classrooms have desks and furniture. Especially every building has its own library. There are certain canteens also with good quality food. Boys and girls have separate hostels and hygiene is also good in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is beautiful teachers are helpful and cooperative, and the placements are okay.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly and the college campus has jammers so cell internet doesn't work. Classrooms are getting better in facilities. There are overpriced snacks and food like coffee around 150ml is for Rs. 40 which is very helpful in summer. The campus events can be good if the management is done properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the campus, really good teaching staff and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The buildings are old. Well-equipped Labs and Classroom. The central library is the famous building of our college. The campus is very large and vast.  It has a hostel facility for girls. There are so many Pgs nearby. The food is very tasty. More than 6 canteens are there. A very sports complex is there with a Gym, basketball court volleyball, football, badminton, and tennis court.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University is one of the best university for the medical students.
reviews.review_text: In our department, lots of facilities are available, like labs, Wi-Fi, a library, sports facilities, and many more. The hostels are very good. In our college, hostel facilities are very good, including the environment of the hostel. Medical facilities are always available for the students.

paragraphs: Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth admission is currently open for all courses. The college offers admission to all the courses that are entrance-based. The college offers MBBS at UG, MD, MS and MSc at PG and DM/MCh at Super Specialty (SS) level all under one roof. Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth conducts application in online mode only. Admission to MD/ MS, DM/ MCh and MBBS is based on national-level entrance exams such asNEET PG,NEET SS,NEET UG, etc. Further, the final seat allotment is done based on the respective counselling process. Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth admission is entrance-based for all courses. The college accepts NEET-UG, NEET-SS and NEET-PG scores, followed by counselling for admission to UG, PG and super speciality courses, respectively. Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth admission 2025 is completely entrance-based for all programmes. The college admissions process is a multi-step process. Candidates looking for admission to any of the programmes must register on the official websites ofNEET-UG,NEET-PG and NEET-SSfor admission. Given below is theMGMCRI admission process 2025:
Step 1:Application Process 2025
Candidates seeking admission to any courses must apply on the official website of the respective entrance exam. The application process is conducted in online mode.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

MGMCRI admission 2025 is strictly based on the score obtained in the entrance exams. For admission to MBBS, MD, MS and super speciality college accepts NEET UG, NEET PG and NEET SS scores, respectively. Every candidate must qualify for these entrance exams for their desired course. Later on, the shortlisted candidates will be allocated seats through a counselling process.
Step 3: Counselling Process

All the NEET qualifiers are required to register forNEET-UG counsellingandNEET-PG counsellingprocess conducted by the MCC on the official website of the conducting body and pay the registration fee and a refundable security deposit. During the choice filling for Round 1, candidates select MGMCRI and choose their desired course with specialisation. Further, round-wiseNEET-UG cutoffandNEET-PG cutoffwill be released on the official website of MCC. Candidates who manage to secure a seat in Round 1 can proceed with the process, whereas the remaining candidates have to appear for other counselling rounds such as Round 2, Mop-up Round, and Stray Vacancy Round.
Step 4: Physical Reporting & Document Verification

Candidates who are allocated seats are required to download their allotment letter and report at Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, Sri Balaji Vidyapeeth in person for the document verification process andMGMCRI feepayment to lock their seats within the stipulated timeline.

The college has a good overall placement scenario, with about 150 students from the course getting placed in 2023. The highest package offered for UG courses is INR 7.1 LPA, and the average package is around INR 6 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Challenging and interesting life phase.
reviews.review_text: There was a little lag in providing the facilitation within the time. Moreover, separate research institutes, like laboratories, were specifically designed for all the disciplines. Even sports facilities were available on the campus, and there was no adequate time to play.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute.
reviews.review_text: I decided to do studies in this organisation based on the environment. The busiest campus where students move here for classroom, training, and libraries. College management rigorously asked the students to follow clock which means being punctual in work.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The campus is placed in a serene environment and gives a healthy atmosphere to those dwelling within. The students have a good encouragement for participating in extracurriculars, in the form of competitions for sports and other forms of arts, infrastructure is provided. There is strict prohibition on ragging and other activities that are deemed unparliamentary, but nonetheless, the students are allowed to enjoy while being in limits. The hostel is furnished well with a good mess, home theatre, ...

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with good infrastructure and facilities of our college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus. Hostel and other basic facilities are available. Medical facilities are provided. Canteen, washrooms, drinking water, and other facilities are available. Our campus is clean and neat.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good college.
reviews.review_text: Library is the best with a silent environment, green area, and Wi-Fi speed are better with 200 Mbps. Hostels are the best and the food is good with a proper diet. Meals are the best and mess is present. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: A perfect college for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is really awesome when compared with other medical colleges in Pondicherry. The classes are fully air conditioned, neat and clean. Our college even has library with internet kiosk zone where we can search anything with full free Wi-Fi facility.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There are dissection labs, and there are labs sessions for every department every year. Our college has libraries, and the Wi-Fi facility is also available. There are single and double occupancy rooms in the hostel, and all the rooms are air-conditioned. The quality of the food served in the hostel is quite good comparatively. There is a canteen inside the hostel as well as near the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A decent deemed college that you opt for
reviews.review_text: There are several lecture halls for each batch and WiFi available in both college and hostel. There is a great library for students to stay concentrated. Mess and canteen are available. Sports events takes place and interested students can participate

reviews.review_heading: Hostel is not worth for the money and pls don't expect the faculty
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and hostel is not worth for the fees paid. I would prefer to stay out and first I would not recommend this college . If you wanna live peacefully just join in other college. Mahatma Gandhi is not worth it for the fees we pay. Just don't join here.

reviews.review_heading: There were good placements for all the previous batches.
reviews.review_text: A library facility is available for students. The library provides free Wi-Fi. The hostel has a separate mess. There is a canteen also.

reviews.review_heading: Best medical school for practical experience.
reviews.review_text: Throughout my time at PIMS, I lived in a hostel. And the best hostel food and no disturbance, the best experience. Our hostel is a five-story building with more than 200 rooms. It's all shared rooms. We had access to Wi-Fi, TV, and indoor games inside our hostel. We have strict times for incoming and outgoing.

reviews.review_heading: Post-graduate program in community medicine.
reviews.review_text: The salary packages absolutely vary for the course years and seasons for placement. Also, hospitals like Kauvery Hospital, Apollo Hospital, and Max Hospital are some of the mostly approachable organisations for recruitment. The package is literally between 3.6 LPA to 14.2 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Highly demanded courses in medicine.
reviews.review_text: Extremely facilitated organisation with good reputation for servicing as well as teaching. There will be 3300 specialized beds arranged for learning and providing various training related to the cases. The organisation well-equipped itself with the needed perquisites.
