The NEET 2024 result for the re-exam, which was conducted on June 23, was declared on July 1, day day after the slated date. The final answer keys for the NEET 2024 re-exam was released by June 30, ahead of the result declaration. Earlier, the result of NEET 2024 was declared by NTA on June 4, 2024, 10 days ahead of the original schedule, which was June 14, 2024. reviews.review_heading: Honest review of a medical college from a medical perspective.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure. All the latest equipment is available here, and classrooms are Smart classrooms. Labs are highly equipped with instruments and trained staff. The canteen is very good, open 18 hours except at night. Various sports options are available like cricket, badminton, kho-kho, basketball, table tennis, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend this college as it is one of the best medical institutions in India.
reviews.review_text: The facilities here are so good that we have Wi-Fi in every classroom, high-quality equipment, and the canteen provides good food. The teachers are good and friendly, and we have designated days for sports and extracurricular activities, as well as gym facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is nice. The college management provides all the basic facilities like auditorium, cafeteria, gym, and medical. Classrooms are well-equipped with digital instruments like projectors and digital boards. The college provides hostel facilities for both boys and girls. In the hostel, they provide both AC and non-AC rooms. It also provides beds, tables, chairs, and a wardrobe. Hostel food is hygienic and students are really satisfied with it.

reviews.review_heading: B.J.M.C. -Learning through Cadavers to Saving Lives .
reviews.review_text: The library is world-class, with a reading room that has facilities for more than 500 students at a time. The library has over 10,000 books and subscriptions. The labs are well-equipped to meet current educational needs. The biochemistry, pathology, and microbiology labs are the best in the state.

reviews.review_heading: B.J.M.C. from the heart of the student.
reviews.review_text: It has got a good library with a very big reading room for students to sit and study, which is open 24 hrs. Good hostel facilities along with home-like food in mess at very affordable rates. It has also got a badminton court, cricket ground, and table tennis.

reviews.review_heading: The college has highly qualified and knowledgeable faculty.
reviews.review_text: This college had good infrastructure available for our course. College hostels are safe for girls and boys. Labs are available, and hospital equipment is fully filled in the hospital. The campus of the college was quite big. There was ample parking space for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Owing to its Fees and patient inflow, it is the best option for MBBS in Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is okayish, the building is quite old and requires some repair. The girls' hostel is somewhat in okay condition, the boys' hostel is good. The classroom has A.C., but desks require repair as many are broken. The practical labs are well-maintained and have sufficient instruments.

reviews.review_heading: My college has all medical facilities available.
reviews.review_text: The well-stocked library centers describe medical facilities offering an extensive collection of books and articles, state-of-the-art laboratories in physiology and pathology, and comprehensive learning. Uninterrupted 24/7 Wi-Fi and medical facilities are available in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty and learning experience.
reviews.review_text: The library is stocked with a large collection of books, journals and articles related to medicine, operation procedures, healthcare. Laboratories included are anatomy labs, physiology labs, pathology labs, microbiology labs, and biochemistry labs. Wi-Fi is available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B. J. Medical College, Ahmedabad.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is the best in Gujarat overall because the mess is handled by second-year students and the food served is excellent. Every Wednesday and Sunday, you will get the best food. Mess is the best in all medical schools.

reviews.review_heading: It is the most prestigious college in Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are in good condition and have air conditioners. In the hostel, two students stay in one room. Each room has 2 beds, 2 chairs, 2 tables, and 2 cupboards. There is a mess available. The food quality is good. We can play all the sports and games on the hostel ground.

reviews.review_heading: It is the top college in Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are in good condition and have air conditioners. In the hostel, two students stay in one room. Each room has 2 beds, 2 chairs, 2 tables, and 2 cupboards. There is a mess available. The food quality is good. We can play all the sports.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Gujarat.
reviews.review_text: It has one of the best libraries. Classrooms are good, and the hostel is the best. You will get a two-seater room with a fan, 2 beds, and 2 cupboards for only Rs. 1200 per annum. Many sports are played. The mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good knowledge for students.
reviews.review_text: All the staff keeps the hospital, and the college campus clean. The reading room facility is good. We have a 24X7 functional reading room and a library which has a good set of books.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is one of the top colleges.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is above average. Lecture theatres are not properly lighted, and have old desks, but are air-conditioned. Food in the canteen is decent, but sports facilities are poor. Hostels are excellent and well-maintained.

review_content.Placements: There are various organizations and companies offering internship roles with stipends. The college has a wide range of networks and coordination with multiple organizations. In our batch, 80 percent of the students were selected by WHO for internships, and after the internship, they were offered jobs. Now, they are employed at WHO.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have different types of clubs like the Journal Club and Publication Club. The college has a large library with a wide range of books that are easily accessible. There is also a digital library with subscriptions to different paid sites where we can access articles and full books in PDF format. The college holds a yearly event where both faculty and students mutually organize and participate. Various sports and other activities are available. Events have featured Bollywood and Hollywood celebrities as chief guests. Our honorable Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi visited the college once during my time, and Shahrukh Khan and other singers have also participated in our college events.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a remarkable college to learn clinical skills, and it has a good reputation.

review_content.Placements: Being a medical college with a very good hospital, 100% of the students get internships after completing their final year. The pay is 10,000 per month as of 2021, which is pretty less compared to government colleges. But the workload is less too. After internships, you have a choice of doing rural service for 80,000 per month, or you can work in the private sector. Everyone will surely get placed somewhere.
review_content.Infrastructure: The most important requirement for an MBBS student is a good hospital. This college has one of the best hospitals. You can find all types of cases. Mess and hostel are okay, but there are many cafes on the campus, which are very good.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The life in JNMC, Belagavi.

content.Placements: In medical college, there are usually no placements. There are just internships and after that, if you wish to work somewhere as an MBBS graduate then JNMC as a college on your resume will look strong as this institution goes back to 1963. Many people have cracked NEET PG from here, and the clinical knowledge you get from the patient flow is amazing.
content.Infrastructure: There is a campus with Wi-Fi that works throughout with good internet speed. There is a world-class library present here. I genuinely love the library as there is no book on medicine, you won't find here. The catalogue is vast and impressive. There is also a reading room that is open for students 24/7. Labs here are also world-class and they incorporated newer technologies into curriculum to enhance the learning process. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and ACs and are generally well thought out.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College review.

content.Placements: There are various organizations and companies offering internship roles with stipends. The college has a wide range of networks and coordination with multiple organizations. In our batch, 80 percent of the students were selected by WHO for internships, and after the internship, they were offered jobs. Now, they are employed at WHO.
content.Infrastructure: We have different types of clubs like the Journal Club and Publication Club. The college has a large library with a wide range of books that are easily accessible. There is also a digital library with subscriptions to different paid sites where we can access articles and full books in PDF format. The college holds a yearly event where both faculty and students mutually organize and participate. Various sports and other activities are available. Events have featured Bollywood and Hollywood celebrities as chief guests. Our honorable Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi visited the college once during my time, and Shahrukh Khan and other singers have also participated in our college events.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is a remarkable college to learn clinical skills, and it has a good reputation.

content.Placements: Being a medical college with a very good hospital, 100% of the students get internships after completing their final year. The pay is 10,000 per month as of 2021, which is pretty less compared to government colleges. But the workload is less too. After internships, you have a choice of doing rural service for 80,000 per month, or you can work in the private sector. Everyone will surely get placed somewhere.
content.Infrastructure: The most important requirement for an MBBS student is a good hospital. This college has one of the best hospitals. You can find all types of cases. Classrooms are huge and comfortable with AC facilities. The library is well-equipped. There's a sports complex and swimming pool, gym and athletic track. Mess and hostel are okay, but there are many cafes on the campus, which are very good.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and cleanliness.

content.Placements: The college doesn't provide placements at all, but a student can continue as a junior doctor in KLE Hospital after completing the internship. There is no placement cell. If someone joins the government set up or private practice, he can easily earn up to Rs. 40,000 as a starting salary. It is better to prepare for PG.
content.Infrastructure: There are no infrastructure related problems. The campus has ATMs, bank, cafe, cooperative store, gym, swimming pool, table tennis, badminton, tennis, basketball, carrom etc. Hostels are well maintained and cleaned at least 2 times a day. Electricity supply is available 24/7. The college and hospital are well-equipped. Wi-Fi facility is available.

reviews.review_heading: Osmania = Best clinical exposure, the name itself stands high, and best for students dreaming high.
reviews.review_text: As it is one of the oldest hospitals in India, the hospital might not have very good infrastructure, but coming to the college, it is good. It is green everywhere, where we get interest to read and indulge in subjects and labs. Hostels and everything are fine, we can manage, and it is overall okay.

reviews.review_heading: Best ever college and worth it.
reviews.review_text: Good facility and everything over here. Good classes and facilities. Good mess and canteen available. Sports and all indoor and outdoor games. Quality of food in the mess and canteen is good, although. Available Wi-Fi is present in the campus premises.

reviews.review_heading: Osmania Medical College is a great college for MBBS, which provides a great exposure.
reviews.review_text: We have great lecture halls for every year and labs for all the subjects, and reference or reading rooms with air conditioning for us to study. A library full of books we need for the course, which are absolutely free with a library card.

reviews.review_heading: College is good for learning but facilities are less.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the hospital where we work for PG OBGY at Osmania Medical College is not very good. Only basic investigations, such as CBP, LFT, RFT, PT/INR, and thyroid profile, are conducted. A blood bank is available in the hospital. Library is available in college which is 10 minutes from hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for MBBS course at low fees.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure should be improved, as all of the buildings are very old. Overall infrastructure is average and some of the buildings are under construction. Library has no option to access online so it needs to be activated. Sports and games are arranged every semester.

reviews.review_heading: You can choose this college for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is improving day by day, though it is currently not at par with the best. The campus has 4 boys hostels, another 7-story hostel building under construction, and 2 girls hostels. The main boys hostel has a Wi-Fi facility, and the new boys hostel does not yet have that facility. The food quality in boys hostels is good, or sometimes average. Regarding the academic environment, the best students in East India mostly choose this college, so you will get enough competition. We have...

reviews.review_heading: Internship facility is good.
reviews.review_text: College: being the 1st medical institute in Asia, its buildings are a bit old, but I can confirm the lecture theatre is very meticulously maintained. Library facilities are extremely good. Wi-Fi is also available inside the academic building. Labs are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: For MBBS, you can get this college with low feels.
reviews.review_text: Our library is peaceful, and it has almost all the books and magazines of a medical student. The college hostel has double-B.Ed. and single-B.Ed. rooms. Clean room. At the mess, they serve three meals daily, with tea and snacks in the evening. PGs and rented rooms are available nearby, but they are very expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is big and spacious. If you are a sports lover, you can get different options to play, such as football, volleyball, and badminton. There are separate badminton courts for the boys and girls. The hostel facility is mandatory for all students.

reviews.review_heading: College with qualified faculty and good quality facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good-quality infrastructure for our course. The facilities at this college were of good quality. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, medical, sports and various other required facilities were given to the students. The food was good to eat. Rooms in the hostel were well furnished.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent medical college.
reviews.review_text: When I talk about the infrastructure of the college, it was really good. It is equipped with a big library and good medical labs and classrooms. Hostel facilities will not be provided to first-year students. The food is really good because it is on the main campus. The terms and conditions of this college are good.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Telangana for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure needs proper renovation. Most of the buildings are old. Other facilities like labs, classrooms, library among the other infrastructure is okay. The hostel has different rules. In the first year, you may face problems because you have to stay with around 20 students in a room. From 2nd year onwards, this problem will be sorted. Food quality of the hostel is not bad.

reviews.review_heading: A College worthy of getting enrolled.
reviews.review_text: Since it’s a very old building it lacks strength but it's not like it will crumble. Hostel gets upgraded depending upon the year you are studying in. For example, 1st years stay in a dorm along with 25 to 30 other students, but in the 2nd year only 4 to 5 students are accommodated  per room.

reviews.review_heading: College of medicine - OMC.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very spacious. We have a basketball court, a cricket court, a gym, a tennis court, and much more. The hostel has a variety of rooms: 2 sharing,  5 sharing, and 4 sharing. The food in the mess will be good. The canteen has a variety of foods, from fast food to fruit salads.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Osmania Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The faculty is highly qualified. Everyone is a doctor. Classrooms are very spacious. The labs are sufficient for the huge strength of the class. We have huge playgrounds where sports are given so much importance. Hostels are not very luxurious. But the food is very good.

review_summary.college_name: Chettinad Academy of Research and Education Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college provides strong placement support with regular training and good company tie-ups.

content.Placements: I am a student of B.Tech (Computer Science and Engineering) at Chettinad Institute of Technology. The placement rate of our college is around 85-90 percent with most students getting placed through campus recruitment. Chettinad Institute of Technology offers good overall placements with around 90 percent of students getting placed every year. Many companies like TCS, Zoho, Tessolve, and KGISL visit the campus. The training and placement cell provides regular aptitude, technical, and interview training. Average packages are moderate while a few students get higher offers depending on their skills. Overall it is a decent college for getting campus placements. They provide a good internship.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Sciences - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: So far, so good. The college is better than I expected.

content.Placements: I am a first batch student, but we are sure we will get placed, it's because of the atmosphere we have here. We are having a very good internship with companies like HCL Tech. They'll pay us a salary also if we do an internship. Our college itself has some companies where we can easily get opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: For our course, everything is good, we have labs and libraries, MATLAB and everything. On our campus, we have a hostel where we can get any treatment. This is more than enough.
content.Faculty: The curriculum is very good. We have six subjects in the first year they are engineering, graphic programming, language communication skills, and Foundation of Engineering Chemistry. The teachers are teaching very well. This is a value for money. In my case, my family had no money at that time, so I thought joining in a less expensive College would decrease the burden. After I joined here, I realised that I am on a great campus. We have a great faculty who are trying to help us improve day by day, not even letting us deviate.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Allied Health Sciences - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities. A better option for medical.

content.Placements: The placements from this college are to Kaveri Hospital, Apollo Hospital, and SRM Global Hospital. They provide internships in these hospitals or their own hospital (Chettinad Hospital) to all the students. I'm studying M.Sc. Integrated Cardiac Technology and Echocardiographers are the ones who are most recruited.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top-notch in this college. Classrooms are with AC. There is Wi-Fi throughout the entire college. They have spacious labs with enough equipment for everyone to use. They have a massive library which provides all the books you want. There is a canteen inside the college and outside the college. About sports and games, they have 3 grounds, an indoor stadium, and many more spaces provided for sports. Regarding the hostel, they provide decent food with different menus including many dishes every day. As there is a hospital near the college, we can get access to great medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review about Chettinad Hospital and Research Institute.

content.Placements: In this college, they provide internships in their own multispecialty hospital, or they tie up with many clinics and hospitals for our internships. They give placements after completing the course, which studies the human anatomy, body issues, and organs, and they place students in famous clinics.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has great infrastructure and many facilities for sports. The college has an indoor stadium and outdoor stadium, giving importance to sports like hockey, basketball, football, cricket, badminton, table tennis, and handball.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This college is a good college.

content.Placements: My college has the basic strength of a law college, and provides scholarship seats based on percentage. They also provide placements in top firms, which makes our career path easier. In fact, 70% of students secured internships in top firms. This college will help us in fixing goals.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good sources to improve students' academics. My mentors were very helpful, not only in making my work perfect, but also in my extracurricular activities. The hostel was good, but the food was not good.

admission_process.title: Chettinad Academy of Research and Education Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: As per the information available on the website, theChettinad Academy of Research and Education admission processis a three-step process. The process begins with the release of the application forms and ends with the payment of the seat booking fee by the selected candidates. Interested candidates can check out the step-wiseCARE admission processfrom below:
CARE application process

The CARE application forms are released on the official website of the college. Interested candidates can fill the application forms after checking the eligibility criteria from the CARE Eligibility and Selection Criteria section.
CARE Selection Rounds

Admission to most of the CARE courses is merit-based. The college accepts national-level entrance exam scores for courses offered by Chettinad Hospital and Research Institute and School of Architecture. Some of the exams accepted by the college include NEET, NATA, etc. The college also conducts its own entrance test - CEAT.
Result declaration and Admission Confirmation

After the shortlisting process is completed, the University releases the course-wise merit list on the official website of the University. Shortlisted candidates are required to pay the admission confirmation fees to secure their seats.

faqs.question: What is the fee for UG courses at Chettinad Academy of Research and Education?
faqs.answer: Chettinad Academy of Research and Education (CARE) was established in 2005 in Kanchipuram. The Institute is approved by UGC and accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC).Chettinad University is a deemed university that provides Undergraduate and Postgraduate courses in several streams. The university conduct the entrance test for the MBBS program. The admission in this programme is based on the merit list of the entrance test. It provides faculty of medicine and home science. Before taking admission to this course, students have to follow the details of the admission process which is available on their official website. Chettinad Academy of Research and Education fees for these courses range from Rs 2 LPA - Rs 13 LPA approximately, depending on the degree level and duration of the course.

faqs.question: Are there any government jobs that I can seek after completing a BSc at Chettinad Academy of Research and Education?
faqs.answer: Pursuing a BSc at Chettinad Academy of Research and Education (CARE) opens doors to multiple jobs in the government sector. As the university offers BSc in multiple disciplines related to the field of Medical and Allied Sciences, most of the graduates seek employment in the healthcare sector. They can work at government hospitals, clinics, health centers, labs, etc. Graduates interested in the field of Research can join government organisations, such as CSIR and ICMR. Further, the education sector also offers a variety of government jobs to CARE BSc graduates. Other sectors where the graduates can seek employement include Banking, Public Administration, Defense, etc.

faqs.question: What are the career prospects of pursuing a BSc at CARE (Deemed University)?
faqs.answer: CARE (Deemed University) offers BSc and BSc (Hons) courses in various specialisations related to the filed of Medical and Allied Sciences. CARE graduates can explore a variety of career opportunities after BSc . These opportunities span across the government and the private sectors. The career prospects ultimately depend on the interests and specialisations of the graduates. Generally, BSc graduates of the university take up job roles in healthcare, research, and education sectors. For career advancement and specialised knowledge, graduates can pursue an MSc degree in the relevant disciplines.

hostel_campus.college_name: M S Ramaiah Medical College Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Review of the MD in Physiology course at M S Ramaiah Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The college copes with obligatory demands that are required for studies. The simulation lab center and specialised laboratories for all disciplines conveniently are located within the college premises. Individual conference halls with all the facilities are available for all the disciplines.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a great college for pursuing MBBS with great faculty and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good; they have a really good library (digital library, scientific journal area, UG and PG areas, etc. ), a good cafeteria, labs are well-equipped, a museum for specimens and a yoga area also. Hostel by Infrastructure is also good and now a new hostel has been made for new batches. The mess is not so good; it has a gym, a TV room and a barbershop also.

reviews.review_heading: MS Ramaiah Medical College Review
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well developed. The library is well equipped, and you can find all the books required for the course, as well as journals for some extra knowledge. There is a sports complex too, where you can play cricket, basketball, etc.; however, there is no swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Mbbs at  MS Ramaiah medical College, Bengaluru
reviews.review_text:
College is very nice, with a very pretty campus having lush green gardens.
There is a separate sports arena, lab facility, central library and full time wifi facility is available in hostel as well as college. Mess is there in hostel that provides cheap and nutritious meal.

reviews.review_heading: MS Ramaiah Medical College review
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great. There is free Wi-Fi in the college premises and the hostel. The lecture halls are well built, and the campus offers food stalls for a quick bite. Also, the campus is located on New Bel Road, where there are multiple food outlets and restaurants.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MS Ramaiah College of Physiotherapy .
reviews.review_text: We have a beautiful campus with great infrastructure, including a library, Wi-Fi, labs and well-equipped classrooms. Hostels, too, are good. The canteen is pretty good and there are a lot of opportunities for sports and games. And of course, the city of Bangalore will make you fall in love with it.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and the best for internship.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure was amazing with all facilities. Our department classrooms were fully furnished with comfortable seats. The library and labs were also equipped with books and equipment. Hostel rooms were also neat and clean. The quality of food in the mess or canteen has a good taste and is also healthy.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college.
reviews.review_text: Labs here are the best in Bangalore. The sports facilities are great, with a basketball court, table tennis, and badminton arena, and a football field as well. Two-seater and three-seater rooms are available for girls. Single rooms are provided for boys. Adequate furniture is provided. A laundry option is available, and a parking lot is also available.

reviews.review_heading: It has the best faculty, and the best clinical experience is provided in physiotherapy.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available at the tip of your hand. The college has huge classrooms, laboratories, and a good park. It has an amazing and huge library with many books available with recent advances. The canteen is huge and amazing, and it offers the best food at reasonable prices.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure, fests, college life, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is up to the mark, and all the labs and equipment are available. The campus is very green and numerous food stalls are present inside the campus. Hostel infrastructure for medical students is also good. The mess is decent, Wi-Fi is below average.

reviews.review_heading: I want to give eight out of 10 for our college overall.
reviews.review_text: Everywhere on campus, you will get Wi-Fi facilities. Labs are very good for studying. In every classroom, you got a digital method of teaching with a projector. In the college, you have got 24 hours library facility. But the big problem is that the hostel is not good as I was expecting. There is no food facility. The gym is available and you have enough space for playing.

reviews.review_heading: The curriculum is quite challenging here.
reviews.review_text: There are the latest technology labs that have new binocular microscopes where images are fully magnified and clear. The sports committee gives opportunities to participate in sports that include cricket and other athletic events. I opted for the hostel, and the rooms are decent. There are varieties of rooms like single occupancy room with washroom attached/not attached and double occupancy with washroom attached/not attached. The fee differs accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good private college in Bangalore for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The classes are taken in big air-conditioner halls with staircase-like rows. Benches have foldable seats and are well maintained, which are very comfortable. The infrastructure of this college is excellent, and well furnished. Washrooms are cleaned regularly. Water purifiers are available. Library is well-equipped, and digital library is also available. The reading room is present to read books. Students can borrow one book per person after making a library card for 2 weeks. Canteen is available...

reviews.review_heading: The best college in India.
reviews.review_text: You will get every type of lab with each and every apparatus here, and you can learn whichever course you are interested in easily. As for my experience, they give the best facilities here, so that you will be aware of what type of things are available around you and how you can use them easily.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, campus and health care facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-equipped classrooms and laboratories. A variety of hotels are available within the campus. A new college is built recently. There is no particular college ground for medical school. Cultural activities here are less compared to other colleges. There is a less scope for native languages.
